praia-da-zambujeira-do-mar.access: Steps and a short path from the village down to the sand.
praia-da-zambujeira-do-mar.parking: Officially about 20 car spaces at the beach, with more in the village.
praia-da-zambujeira-do-mar.food: Cafes and restaurants in the village above the beach.
praia-da-zambujeira-do-mar.note: Lifeguards in summer. Surf reports describe a heavy, hollow break; swim and surf with care.

punta-rata-beach.access: Walk from the village promenade or car park; flat and easy.
punta-rata-beach.parking: A paid car park, reported at around 4 EUR an hour or up to about 25 EUR a day in season; nearby hotel lots can be cheaper.
punta-rata-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for hire; prices vary widely by source, from about 5-7 EUR each to about 28 EUR for a pair.
punta-rata-beach.food: Beach bars and restaurants along the promenade; public toilets may need coins.
punta-rata-beach.note: No entry fee for the public beach; shade from the pines until about 5-6 pm. Very crowded in August.

makarska-beach.access: Walk directly from the promenade onto the beach; easy.
makarska-beach.parking: Paid city parking; hotel car parks charge separately, around 8 EUR a day at some hotels.
makarska-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas cost extra; no current price found.
makarska-beach.food: Restaurants, cafes and shops along the promenade.
makarska-beach.note: Showers and changing areas near the small pebble beaches at the front. Crowded in summer.

zaton-beach.access: Flat walk from the resort and nearby streets.
zaton-beach.parking: Free parking advertised at the resort; check local signs.
zaton-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for hire; some visitors call prices high.
zaton-beach.food: Bars and restaurants nearby and in the resort.
zaton-beach.note: Gently shelving water, good for children. Some stretches are pebbly.

lacanau-ocean-beach.access: Stairs from the paid car parks at the central beach.
lacanau-ocean-beach.parking: Paid parking in the centre fills fast in season; a large car park to the south gives access to the quieter Super Sud beach.
lacanau-ocean-beach.sunbeds: No sunbeds reported at the main beach; bring a towel.
lacanau-ocean-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants along the front.
lacanau-ocean-beach.note: The Grande Aire Oceane motorhome area is paid (about 15.50 EUR per 24 hours in 2025-2026, plus a lifetime 5 EUR Camping Car Park membership). Dog rules vary by beach.

hossegor-lake-beach.access: Short walk from the entrance car park; accessible with an amphibious chair in summer.
hossegor-lake-beach.parking: A small free car park at the entrance; parking on a nearby street too.
hossegor-lake-beach.sunbeds: No sunbeds reported; paddle rental available.
hossegor-lake-beach.food: A bar and food outlet on the beach.
hossegor-lake-beach.note: Lifeguards from late May to late September (schedule varies); dogs are not allowed per the Landes tourism board.

plage-d-argent.access: Ferry to Porquerolles, then about 20 minutes on foot or 10 on a bike from the village.
plage-d-argent.parking: No cars allowed; bike parking at the beach.
plage-d-argent.sunbeds: Sunbed rental listed by tourism sources; no price found.
plage-d-argent.food: A bar-restaurant, toilets and a rescue post in season.
plage-d-argent.note: Tiralo amphibious chair for bathing in season. The island is in a national park, so follow park rules.

cap-ferret-ocean-beach.access: A short walk over the dunes from the car park, about 15 minutes at some beaches.
cap-ferret-ocean-beach.parking: Parking sits before the dunes; some beaches have a small car park at the foot of the dune.
cap-ferret-ocean-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants in Cap Ferret village; a pinasse boat crosses from Arcachon.
cap-ferret-ocean-beach.note: Some stretches are unsupervised and partly naturist; the ocean has strong currents.

paradise-beach.access: Easy by road, or by bus and taxi boat from Mykonos Town and Platis Gialos.
paradise-beach.parking: Parking near the beach is limited and fills quickly in summer.
paradise-beach.sunbeds: Beach clubs rent sunbeds and umbrellas; prices vary by venue and season.
paradise-beach.food: Bars, restaurants and beach clubs along the shore, plus toilets and showers.
paradise-beach.note: A lively party beach; much quieter in the morning and outside July and August.

anthony-quinn-bay.access: Easy; steps and paths lead from the road down to the water.
anthony-quinn-bay.parking: Small car park near the cove; limited spaces and busy in summer.
anthony-quinn-bay.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire on the platforms.
anthony-quinn-bay.food: A seasonal snack bar and tavernas nearby; confirm opening times.
anthony-quinn-bay.note: Rocky entry, so water shoes are recommended. Best early in the day before tour groups arrive.

tsilivi-beach.access: Easy; the beach runs beside the road and a promenade.
tsilivi-beach.parking: Roadside parking and small lots along the beach road; busy in July and August.
tsilivi-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire at the beach bars.
tsilivi-beach.food: Beach bars and tavernas along the shore.
tsilivi-beach.note: A busy resort beach with water sports; the water deepens gradually.

falasarna-beach.access: Easy; a paved road reaches the beach, then a short walk across the sand.
falasarna-beach.parking: Free parking by the beach; it fills in the middle of summer.
falasarna-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire in the main area.
falasarna-beach.food: Tavernas and snack bars behind the beach; confirm opening times.
falasarna-beach.note: Famous for sunsets. The sea can be rough on windy days, so check conditions.

cala-cipolla.access: Easy; a short walk from the car park.
cala-cipolla.parking: Limited free parking near the beach; arrive early in summer.
cala-cipolla.sunbeds: Few or no rentals reported; bring your own umbrella.
cala-cipolla.food: Few facilities at the beach; Chia has restaurants and shops nearby.
cala-cipolla.note: A quieter option near Chia; check local signs for current rules.

baia-dei-turchi.access: Moderate; a path through pinewood and dunes from the car park.
baia-dei-turchi.parking: Parking areas near the pine wood; busy and often paid in summer.
baia-dei-turchi.sunbeds: Some seasonal rentals reported; availability varies.
baia-dei-turchi.food: A seasonal bar or kiosk; Otranto has restaurants nearby.
baia-dei-turchi.note: Protected coastal area; dunes and vegetation are fragile.

spiaggia-di-serapo.access: Easy; the beach runs alongside the promenade.
spiaggia-di-serapo.parking: Street parking and paid car parks nearby; fills in August.
spiaggia-di-serapo.sunbeds: Lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; free sections remain between them.
spiaggia-di-serapo.food: Bars and restaurants along the promenade, plus showers and toilets at the lidos.
spiaggia-di-serapo.note: A popular family beach; very busy around mid-August.

lido-di-camaiore.access: Easy; the beach is beside the promenade.
lido-di-camaiore.parking: Paid street parking and car parks near the promenade; busy in summer.
lido-di-camaiore.sunbeds: Most of the beach is run by paid bathing establishments; free public sections are limited.
lido-di-camaiore.food: Bars and restaurants along the front and at the establishments.
lido-di-camaiore.note: Gently shelving sandy bottom; lifeguards at the establishments in season.

spiaggia-di-rimini.access: Easy; flat access from the promenade and town streets.
spiaggia-di-rimini.parking: Paid car parks and street parking; busy in July and August.
spiaggia-di-rimini.sunbeds: Most of the beach is run by paid establishments; some free sections remain.
spiaggia-di-rimini.food: Bars, restaurants and kiosks all along the front.
spiaggia-di-rimini.note: Very wide and shallow, so it suits children; lively and crowded in peak summer.

cala-benirras.access: Easy by road; a short walk down to the cove.
cala-benirras.parking: Small parking areas near the cove; they fill early in summer.
cala-benirras.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available in season.
cala-benirras.food: Beach bars and restaurants right by the sand.
cala-benirras.note: Sunday sunset drumming is popular; expect crowds and noise.

playa-de-levante.access: Easy; flat access from the promenade and the old town.
playa-de-levante.parking: Paid underground and street parking in the city; limited in summer.
playa-de-levante.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire.
playa-de-levante.food: Many bars and restaurants along the promenade.
playa-de-levante.note: A wide, popular city beach with lifeguards in season.

playa-de-san-lorenzo.access: Easy; the beach is steps from the promenade and the city centre.
playa-de-san-lorenzo.parking: Paid street and underground parking in the city; busy in summer.
playa-de-san-lorenzo.sunbeds: Sunbeds are not typical here; bring a towel or windbreak.
playa-de-san-lorenzo.food: Cafes and restaurants along the promenade; beach bars in season.
playa-de-san-lorenzo.note: Large tidal range and cold water; lifeguards in season.

playa-de-la-malvarrosa.access: Easy; reachable by tram or bus from central Valencia.
playa-de-la-malvarrosa.parking: Paid street parking nearby; limited on summer weekends.
playa-de-la-malvarrosa.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for rent.
playa-de-la-malvarrosa.food: Many chiringuitos and paella restaurants along the front.
playa-de-la-malvarrosa.note: A wide city beach with showers and lifeguards in season.

sitges-beach.access: Easy; the beach is a few steps from the old town.
sitges-beach.parking: Paid car parks in town; spaces near the beach are limited.
sitges-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire in season.
sitges-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants in the old town and along the promenade.
sitges-beach.note: A popular town beach; busy at weekends in summer.

praia-de-ofir.access: Easy; walkways cross the dunes to the sand.
praia-de-ofir.parking: Free parking near the beach; busy in July and August.
praia-de-ofir.sunbeds: Sunbeds are not typical; bring a windbreak and an umbrella.
praia-de-ofir.food: Beach bars and restaurants near the access points.
praia-de-ofir.note: Strong surf and currents; swim only at supervised areas.

praia-dos-pescadores.access: Easy; reached through a tunnel and ramps from the old town.
praia-dos-pescadores.parking: Paid public car parks near the old town; limited in summer.
praia-dos-pescadores.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire.
praia-dos-pescadores.food: Many restaurants and bars around the beach.
praia-dos-pescadores.note: A very popular beach; lifeguards in season.

praia-da-costa-nova.access: Easy; boardwalks cross from the road to the sand.
praia-da-costa-nova.parking: Free and paid parking along the road behind the beach; busy in July and August.
praia-da-costa-nova.sunbeds: Sunbeds are not typical; bring a windbreak.
praia-da-costa-nova.food: Seafood restaurants and bars in the village.
praia-da-costa-nova.note: Strong waves; swim only at supervised areas.

praia-do-carvoeiro.access: Easy; the beach is at the foot of the village streets.
praia-do-carvoeiro.parking: Paid parking in the village; limited in summer.
praia-do-carvoeiro.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire.
praia-do-carvoeiro.food: Cafes and restaurants right at the beach.
praia-do-carvoeiro.note: A small, busy village beach; lifeguards in season.

jagodna-beach.access: Moderate; a short walk from the road to the cove.
jagodna-beach.parking: Roadside parking with limited spaces; arrive early in summer.
jagodna-beach.sunbeds: A few rentals may operate in season; confirm locally.
jagodna-beach.food: Limited facilities; Hvar Town has restaurants and shops.
jagodna-beach.note: A quiet pebble cove; water shoes recommended.

girandella-beach.access: Easy; a promenade runs along the shore.
girandella-beach.parking: Paid parking in Rabac; limited in July and August.
girandella-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire.
girandella-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants along the promenade.
girandella-beach.note: A family resort beach; water shoes recommended.

medulin-beach.access: Easy; paths and a promenade run along the bay.
medulin-beach.parking: Paid parking in Medulin; limited in summer.
medulin-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire at several beaches.
medulin-beach.food: Bars, cafes and restaurants along the coast.
medulin-beach.note: A family-friendly bay; water shoes recommended.

podgora-beach.access: Easy; a promenade runs along the shore.
podgora-beach.parking: Paid parking in town and near the beach; busy in July and August.
podgora-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for hire.
podgora-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants along the front.
podgora-beach.note: A quieter Makarska Riviera beach; water shoes recommended.

plage-de-la-croisette.access: Easy; flat access from the promenade.
plage-de-la-croisette.parking: Paid parking garages nearby; limited and costly in summer.
plage-de-la-croisette.sunbeds: Private beach clubs rent sunbeds; some public sections remain.
plage-de-la-croisette.food: Restaurants and cafes along the boulevard and at the clubs.
plage-de-la-croisette.note: Busy during festivals; public sections fill early.

plage-de-la-salis.access: Easy; flat access from the road and promenade.
plage-de-la-salis.parking: Paid parking in Antibes; limited in summer.
plage-de-la-salis.sunbeds: Beach clubs rent sunbeds and umbrellas; a public section remains.
plage-de-la-salis.note: A calm family beach; public areas fill early.

dinard-beach.access: Easy; steps and ramps lead from the promenade.
dinard-beach.parking: Paid street parking in Dinard; limited in summer.
dinard-beach.sunbeds: Beach cabins can be rented; sunbeds are not typical.
dinard-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants on the seafront.
dinard-beach.note: Very large tidal range; check times and flags.

lapad-beach.access: Easy; promenade beaches on the Lapad peninsula.
lapad-beach.parking: Parking not confirmed; bus from Old Town about 10 minutes
lapad-beach.food: Restaurants on the Lapad promenade such as Levanat and Orsan.
lapad-beach.note: Splendid Beach is calmer. Lapad is about 3 km from the Old Town.

trstenica-beach.access: Easy; beach inside the Trstenica campsite area, about 1 km of sand and pebbles.
trstenica-beach.parking: Private parking at the campsite; free private parking at nearby apartments
trstenica-beach.sunbeds: Deck chairs and umbrellas for rent.
trstenica-beach.food: A restaurant and coffee bar within 10 m of the campsite; beach bar.
trstenica-beach.note: Showers, jet ski rental and parasailing. Aqua park nearby.

plage-de-la-garoupe.access: Easy; bus 2 or 15 from Antibes, or a 40 minute walk from the old town.
plage-de-la-garoupe.parking: Free car park on Avenue Andre Sella, open 24 hours; busy on weekends
plage-de-la-garoupe.sunbeds: Rental loungers and umbrellas at the private Plage Keller; a small public section remains.
plage-de-la-garoupe.food: Le Rocher, La Petite Garoupe and the Plage Keller restaurant; book ahead.
plage-de-la-garoupe.note: Under 40 m of the roughly 150 m beach is freely public. Free showers and toilets; no lifeguard in the public area.

plage-des-catalans.access: City beach in Marseille reached by stairs from the road above.
plage-des-catalans.food: Beach kiosk and small restaurant; many bars and restaurants above the steps.
plage-des-catalans.note: Lifeguards 1 June to 2 September, hours about 8:30 or 9:30 to 19:00. Open about 7:00 to 22:00 or 23:00. Check for closures.

jesolo-beach.parking: Blue-line paid parking about EUR 0.50-1.90 per hour; central zone capped at four hours
jesolo-beach.sunbeds: Umbrella and two sunbeds about EUR 20-35 per day in peak season (guide); front rows need booking.
jesolo-beach.note: Blue Flag in some stretches. Showers, toilets and changing cabins at the clubs.

pizzomunno-beach.access: Flat promenade with several access points.
pizzomunno-beach.sunbeds: Lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; free public areas for your own gear.
pizzomunno-beach.food: Bars and restaurants at the lidos.

spiaggia-della-purita.access: Walk from the old town; a free public beach with shallow water.
spiaggia-della-purita.parking: No parking at the beach; a paid guarded lot in the port about 200-300 m away
spiaggia-della-purita.sunbeds: Not confirmed; no sunbeds on the sand, nearest lidos at Baia Verde about 2 km away.
spiaggia-della-purita.food: No facilities on the sand; restaurants in the old town.
spiaggia-della-purita.note: No changing rooms. Old town traffic is restricted May to September.

playa-de-la-carihuela.parking: Parking nearby; hard to find in July and August; local bus L-1
playa-de-la-carihuela.food: Little wooden beach bars; Chiringuito El Gato at the western end for espetos.
playa-de-la-carihuela.note: Lifeguards 1 June to 30 September near the Tourist Office. Showers and water sports.

playa-de-poniente.access: Flat urban beach with step-free access.
playa-de-poniente.parking: Reports conflict between a free lot and paid garages; check on arrival
playa-de-poniente.sunbeds: About 1,700 sunbeds over 10 sectors; about EUR 18 for two and an umbrella (reported).
playa-de-poniente.note: 89 foot showers; five lifeguard towers in summer.

praia-de-armacao-de-pera.access: Flat town beach with a promenade.
praia-de-armacao-de-pera.parking: Paid lot near Pescadores beach; free parking at the western end of the promenade near the boat ramps
praia-de-armacao-de-pera.food: Many restaurants along the promenade such as Papa and Companhia and A Lota.
praia-de-armacao-de-pera.note: Blue Flag listed and lifeguards in season. Toilets and showers.

mogren-beach.access: Footpath from Budva old town past the Dancing Girl statue; two beaches linked by a tunnel.
mogren-beach.parking: Limited informal parking uphill near the road to Mogren Fortress; walking from the old town is advised
mogren-beach.sunbeds: Sunbed pairs with an umbrella EUR 15-25 depending on row and month; a small free strip may exist.
mogren-beach.food: Beach bars on the sand; Budva old town is close.
mogren-beach.note: Arrive before 10 am in July and August for free space.

plage-de-cavalaire.parking: Free blue-zone parking (1h30) on Allee de la Plage; other lots paid
plage-de-cavalaire.sunbeds: Mattress rental at private beaches along the boulevard.
plage-de-cavalaire.food: Beach bars and a few paillotes, especially near Pardigon.
plage-de-cavalaire.note: Lifeguard post, toilets, showers and changing cabins. Beach alternates between private and public sections.

faliraki-beach.access: Long sandy beach, with Blue Flag status on certain sections only.
faliraki-beach.parking: Sources conflict: informal roadside areas and small lots near the water park, harbour and behind the strip, limited at weekends and in August.
faliraki-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas widely rented, about 5 EUR per person reported.
faliraki-beach.food: Many bars and tavernas along the beach.
faliraki-beach.note: Lifeguards mainly in high season on the Blue Flag sections.

perissa-beach.parking: Ample parking reported; fee not confirmed
perissa-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas; about EUR 10 for two (single review).
perissa-beach.food: Many bars and restaurants along the shore.
perissa-beach.note: Black volcanic sand gets hot; water shoes help.

spiaggia-di-riccione.parking: Many bagni offer discounted car parks; fees not confirmed
spiaggia-di-riccione.sunbeds: Bagni rent umbrellas and sunbeds; prices rise closer to the sea.
spiaggia-di-riccione.food: Bars and restaurants at the bagni.
spiaggia-di-riccione.note: Many lifeguards and first aid along the beach. Beach Village has a waterpark with sunbeds at about EUR 4.

spiaggia-di-alassio.access: Long town beach; the free beach is reached by a small path beside a private lido entrance.
spiaggia-di-alassio.parking: Parking is hard; reports of about EUR 15 across the road. Arrive early.
spiaggia-di-alassio.sunbeds: Lidos charge about EUR 15-40 for an umbrella and two sunbeds; free sections have a free shower.
spiaggia-di-alassio.food: Beach bars and restaurants close by.
spiaggia-di-alassio.note: Details come from several mixed sources; confirm prices locally.

spiaggia-di-termoli.access: Easy; flat sandy beach along the Lungomare.
spiaggia-di-termoli.parking: Free and paid parking near the Lungomare; fills quickly
spiaggia-di-termoli.sunbeds: Lidos rent umbrellas and chairs; a free beach without services also exists.
spiaggia-di-termoli.food: Lido bar and restaurant; beach showers cost a small fee.
spiaggia-di-termoli.note: Often called Lungomare Nord. Popular in summer, so arrive early.

praia-de-quarteira.parking: Car park hard in summer; park in town and walk
praia-de-quarteira.sunbeds: Sunbed and umbrella rental; can sell out in summer.
praia-de-quarteira.food: Promenade restaurants such as Taberna do Peixe and BJ s Oceanside.
praia-de-quarteira.note: Blue Flag in listings. Lifeguards until about 6-7 pm. Showers and toilets.

plage-de-la-grande-conche.parking: Free parking listed for the beach
plage-de-la-grande-conche.sunbeds: Wooden sunbeds and parasols; about EUR 12.50 per day (reported).
plage-de-la-grande-conche.food: Seafront restaurants, cafes and ice cream parlours; L Atelier has ocean views.
plage-de-la-grande-conche.note: Supervised zone with flags; July and August hours about 11 am to 7 pm (2026 schedule). Dogs banned April to September. Beach club and equipment rental.

plage-de-deauville.access: Flat beach beside the Planches promenade.
plage-de-deauville.parking: Paid parking along the beach behind the bathing establishments; very busy in summer
plage-de-deauville.sunbeds: Famous Deauville parasols for rent; 450 beach cabins rented by the day or season.
plage-de-deauville.food: Bars and restaurants among the cabins such as Ciro s and Bar du Soleil; pricey.
plage-de-deauville.note: The 643 m Planches promenade runs along the beach.

grande-plage-de-quiberon.access: Easy; flat promenade beach. Half-day beach chair rental for reduced mobility from the rescue post.
grande-plage-de-quiberon.parking: Paid lots in town (Quai de l Ocean, rue de Port Maria); hard to find in peak season
grande-plage-de-quiberon.food: Bars, restaurants and ice cream shops along the Promenade de la Plage.
grande-plage-de-quiberon.note: Summer lifeguard post, first aid station, showers and toilets. Beach club for children.

crikvenica-beach.access: Easy; city beach on a palm-lined promenade.
crikvenica-beach.parking: Several car parks; details not confirmed
crikvenica-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds rented at nearby beaches such as Kacjak.
crikvenica-beach.food: Two restaurants on the beach and promenade cafes.
crikvenica-beach.note: Free showers, two playgrounds, volleyball, boat rental and three security towers. Blue Flag history; check current status.

umag-beach.access: Easy; resort beaches such as Osmica and Katoro.
umag-beach.parking: Limited for non-guests; spaces on the main road opposite Sol Stella Resort
umag-beach.sunbeds: Loungers and umbrellas for rent; at Osmica and Aurora.
umag-beach.food: Bars and restaurants; Marea restaurant at the main beach.
umag-beach.note: Tourist train links the resorts. Arrive early.

saranda-beach.access: Pebble strip along the Saranda promenade.
saranda-beach.parking: Parking in the centre not confirmed.
saranda-beach.sunbeds: Sunbed and umbrella rental about 500 to 1000 ALL (about 5 to 10 EUR) per set.
saranda-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants within steps; pricier than much of Albania.
saranda-beach.note: Showers nearby. Promenade livelier after sunset. More scenic beaches are outside town.

jonufer-beach.access: Jonufer coast south of Vlora with hotel beaches.
jonufer-beach.parking: Free parking at some hotels; parking is scarce in high season at nearby pebble beaches.
jonufer-beach.sunbeds: Hotel beach areas have loungers and umbrellas; public rental not confirmed.
jonufer-beach.food: Hotel restaurants; Vlora Lungomare has many cafes.
jonufer-beach.note: Little beach-specific information found; check locally.

primosten-beach.access: Walk from town; two pebble stretches, Mala and Velika Raduca.
primosten-beach.parking: Limited parking nearby; most visitors walk
primosten-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds for rent; about EUR 18 for two chairs and a parasol (reported at Velika Raduca).
primosten-beach.food: Bars and restaurants behind Velika Raduca, plus beach bars in pine shade.
primosten-beach.note: Changing rooms, toilets and showers. Mala Raduca has a trampoline for kids.

spiaggia-di-sirolo.access: Steep paths down to the beach; they can be difficult.
spiaggia-di-sirolo.parking: Paid and limited; a flat-rate car park near the Sirolo cemetery is reported.
spiaggia-di-sirolo.food: Bars and restaurants on the beach (reported).
spiaggia-di-sirolo.note: Dark rocks on the seabed and deep water close to shore make it popular for snorkelling. Details come from guides to the Sassi Neri area.

spiaggia-di-gabicce-mare.parking: Some free beaches have parking; capacity unconfirmed
spiaggia-di-gabicce-mare.sunbeds: About 40 beaches and bathing areas rent parasols and sunbeds.
spiaggia-di-gabicce-mare.food: Bars and restaurants at the bagni.
spiaggia-di-gabicce-mare.note: Showers and restrooms at the bagni. Prices not confirmed.

spiaggia-di-sabaudia.access: Wooden walkways from the main road cross the dunes.
spiaggia-di-sabaudia.parking: Limited free parking; paid parking about EUR 1 per hour at the entrance. Arrive by 7:30 or at lunchtime.
spiaggia-di-sabaudia.sunbeds: Lido sets of an umbrella and two loungers about EUR 30-35; free areas too.
spiaggia-di-sabaudia.note: Dunes belong to Circeo National Park. Private parking shuttles run.

platja-de-lloret.access: Platja Gran of about 1,630 m with Blue Flag and a family area.
platja-de-lloret.parking: Sources differ: unpatrolled lot of 100+ spaces, paid spots nearest the beach, and a municipal car park to the north.
platja-de-lloret.food: Beach kiosks, bars and chiringuitos on the sand.
platja-de-lloret.note: Lifeguards in summer, showers and public toilets.

platja-gran-tossa-de-mar.parking: Hard in summer. A nearby car park is reported at EUR 4 per hour; otherwise park outside the centre and walk.
platja-gran-tossa-de-mar.sunbeds: Sunbed hire is listed by the tourist board, but one visitor saw few rental spots.
platja-gran-tossa-de-mar.food: Bars and restaurants along the promenade.
platja-gran-tossa-de-mar.note: Very busy in summer but there is usually room for a towel.

playa-de-peniscola.access: Easy; flat sand about 5.5 km long.
playa-de-peniscola.sunbeds: Sun loungers and umbrellas for rent.
playa-de-peniscola.food: Beach bars and restaurants along the promenade.
playa-de-peniscola.note: Blue Flag beach running from the castle toward Benicarlo.

playa-de-les-marines-denia.access: Wide sandy urban beach with step-free promenade access; accessible parking on Mascarell St and in Les Bassetes Park.
playa-de-les-marines-denia.parking: Street parking along the seafront plus accessible spaces on Mascarell St and Les Bassetes Park; a bus stop is by the beach.
playa-de-les-marines-denia.sunbeds: Sunbed and parasol rental from stands on C/Picardo and C/Esparver, 1 July to 30 September.
playa-de-les-marines-denia.food: Beach bar at Albaranes on C/Boga (1 July to 30 October); some chiringuitos do not open before July.
playa-de-les-marines-denia.note: Lifeguard 1 June to 30 September (weekends and holidays to 12 October), July-August 10:30-20:00. Blue Flag 2025.

playa-del-arenal-javea.access: Flat town beach with a promenade.
playa-del-arenal-javea.parking: Parking listed; capacity and cost not confirmed
playa-del-arenal-javea.food: Beach bar and restaurants and bars along the promenade.
playa-del-arenal-javea.note: Blue Flag. Red Cross lifeguards from Easter with several towers. Showers, toilets, foot wash and disabled access.

playa-arenal-bol-calpe.parking: Parking garage reported nearby; cost not confirmed
playa-arenal-bol-calpe.sunbeds: Sun loungers and umbrellas for rent.
playa-arenal-bol-calpe.note: Blue Flag. Toilets, playground and lifeguards; reports differ on showers.

spiaggia-di-peschici.access: Mix of private lidos and free public beach.
spiaggia-di-peschici.parking: Paid and free parking near the lidos; parking has been a problem in town
spiaggia-di-peschici.sunbeds: Lidos charge for sunbeds and umbrellas.
spiaggia-di-peschici.food: Lido bars and restaurants such as Baia di Peschici.
spiaggia-di-peschici.note: Details for the main public beach are thin; Lido Orchidea is about 2 km from town.

spiaggia-di-sanremo.access: Sandy beaches with lidi and free equipped areas; Lido Imperatrice has a 190 m golden sand stretch near the casino.
spiaggia-di-sanremo.parking: Seafront parking vouchers sold at some lidi; public parking details not confirmed.
spiaggia-di-sanremo.sunbeds: Lidi rent loungers and umbrellas; free areas with your own towel.
spiaggia-di-sanremo.food: Beach restaurants such as Il Sestante in Bussana.
spiaggia-di-sanremo.note: Cabins and hot showers at some lidi. Eight free equipped beaches run by the municipality.

spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.access: Easy at Marina di Maratea; beaches are spread over about 30 km of coast.
spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.parking: Parking not confirmed; a car is recommended on this coast
spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.sunbeds: Lidos and hotel beaches rent sunbeds; not confirmed for this beach.
spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.food: Bars and restaurants at the marina.
spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.note: Details are thin for this exact beach; check with the lido.

spiaggia-di-scalea.access: Long Tyrrhenian beach with lively central lidi near the old town and calmer stretches north and south.
spiaggia-di-scalea.parking: Paid and free areas; use only marked paid bays, beware of unofficial attendants.
spiaggia-di-scalea.note: Free stretches near the Lao river mouth and the pier. Railway station and A2 exit nearby.

spiaggia-di-marzamemi.access: Easy from the village; free and equipped sections.
spiaggia-di-marzamemi.parking: Guarded parking at the south entrance (beach club)
spiaggia-di-marzamemi.sunbeds: Beach club rents umbrellas and sunbeds; free showers.
spiaggia-di-marzamemi.food: Bars and fish restaurants in the old fishing village.
spiaggia-di-marzamemi.note: Calamosche is a separate beach; no data found for it.

spiaggia-guidi-carloforte.access: Beach on San Pietro island, about 5 miles north of Carloforte.
spiaggia-guidi-carloforte.parking: Parking listed at the beach bar; details not confirmed
spiaggia-guidi-carloforte.sunbeds: Not confirmed; nearby La Bobba has a rental kiosk.

plage-de-sainte-maxime.parking: Free car park at the avenue du General Touzet du Vigier; hard to find in summer
plage-de-sainte-maxime.sunbeds: Mattress and deckchair rental at the beach restaurants.
plage-de-sainte-maxime.food: Restaurants serve lunch and dinner with feet in the sand.
plage-de-sainte-maxime.note: Lifeguard station June 12 to September 13 (2026), 10:00-18:00 in June and September and 10:00-19:00 in July and August. Showers, toilets and a water sports base.

plage-des-sablettes-menton.access: Free public fine-gravel beach about 350 m long between the two ports, reached from the seafront promenade.
plage-des-sablettes-menton.parking: Paid underground car park right next to the beach; street parking is scarce in summer.
plage-des-sablettes-menton.sunbeds: Not confirmed on the public beach; sunbeds are offered at neighbouring private beach-restaurants.
plage-des-sablettes-menton.food: Promenade shops, restaurants and bars along the seafront.
plage-des-sablettes-menton.note: Monitored in summer. Gravel underfoot, so bring water shoes.

plage-de-saint-jean-de-luz.access: Flat town beach (Grande Plage) with a promenade; streets near the beach are car free.
plage-de-saint-jean-de-luz.parking: Two secure car parks: Indigo Coeur de Ville and Indigo Grande Plage
plage-de-saint-jean-de-luz.sunbeds: Sunbeds, windbreaks and tents for rent; four beach clubs.
plage-de-saint-jean-de-luz.food: Many cafes, bars and restaurants around the beach.
plage-de-saint-jean-de-luz.note: Lifeguards from about 11 am from June to mid-September (hours vary). Showers and toilets.

plage-du-bon-secours-saint-malo.access: Short walk from the walled town of Saint-Malo.
plage-du-bon-secours-saint-malo.parking: Park outside the walls; no beach lot confirmed
plage-du-bon-secours-saint-malo.note: Tidal sea water pool with diving boards (about 3 m and 5 m), open in summer and free. Grand Be islet is reachable on foot only at low tide. Supervised beach in summer.

praia-da-figueira-da-foz.access: Wide, flat sand; it can take about ten minutes to walk from the promenade to the water.
praia-da-figueira-da-foz.food: Bar and restaurant at Relogio beach.
praia-da-figueira-da-foz.note: The town claims Europe widest beach, a stretch of sand about 2 km long.

praia-da-vagueira.access: Wide open Atlantic sand reached from a large paved parking area beside the beach.
praia-da-vagueira.parking: Large paved parking beside the beach, built with motorhomes in mind.
praia-da-vagueira.sunbeds: Not confirmed; no organised rental reported.
praia-da-vagueira.food: Marisqueira da Vagueira and Mare Restaurante are nearby.
praia-da-vagueira.note: Free public showers and toilets reported (2013 blog); lifeguard not confirmed. Atlantic currents can be strong.

durres-beach.access: Long public beach with a promenade; free to access.
durres-beach.parking: Parking areas along the coast near restaurants and hotels.
durres-beach.sunbeds: Beachfront hotels and operators rent sunbeds and umbrellas in summer; you can bring your own.
durres-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants along the promenade; sunset terrace at the south end of Bulevardi Epidamn.
durres-beach.note: Showers, changing rooms and kiosks in many areas. Crowded in July and August.

bibione-beach.access: Easy; flat sand in the central Lido del Sole zone.
bibione-beach.parking: Free and paid lots nearby; nearest about 300 m
bibione-beach.sunbeds: Umbrella and sunbeds about EUR 17 per day (reported); first row about EUR 60 per week.
bibione-beach.note: Lifeguards and bathrooms; season about mid-May to mid-September. Calm shallow water.

playa-de-benicassim.access: Beach about 600 m by 30 m (Voramar area) with assisted bathing for people with reduced mobility.
playa-de-benicassim.parking: Parking not confirmed; street parking in the Voramar area fills up in summer.
playa-de-benicassim.sunbeds: Umbrella, lounger and pedal boat hire.
playa-de-benicassim.food: Chiringuitos are mainly at Heliopolis, further along the seafront.
playa-de-benicassim.note: First aid post, toilets, showers and footbaths.

spiaggia-di-levante-terracina.access: Wide sandy beach with both free and managed (lido) areas.
spiaggia-di-levante-terracina.parking: Parking near the centre and along the seafront.
spiaggia-di-levante-terracina.sunbeds: Lido areas rent sunbeds and umbrellas; free areas are open to all.
spiaggia-di-levante-terracina.food: Bars and restaurants along the seafront.
spiaggia-di-levante-terracina.note: Details are thin; check with the lido you plan to use.

spiaggia-di-giardini-naxos.access: Easy; flat; mix of sand and pebbles.
spiaggia-di-giardini-naxos.parking: Paid street parking; many machines do not take cards
spiaggia-di-giardini-naxos.sunbeds: Paid lidos with sunbeds and umbrellas; free stretches too.
spiaggia-di-giardini-naxos.food: Restaurants and snack bars at the concessions.
spiaggia-di-giardini-naxos.note: Water shoes help on pebbles. Recanati to the south is mostly pebble.

spiaggia-di-cattolica.access: Long Romagna sand beach lined with bagni (lidi).
spiaggia-di-cattolica.sunbeds: Umbrella and sunbeds at lidi; Romagna typical prices about 24 to 30 EUR per day (not Cattolica specific).
spiaggia-di-cattolica.note: Cabins, pools and fitness areas at some lidi.

spiaggia-di-caorle.sunbeds: Umbrella with two loungers roughly EUR 7-25 depending on the lido (general Caorle).
spiaggia-di-caorle.food: Chiosco Havana is a beach bar with terrace.

spiaggia-di-finale-ligure.access: Flat Ligurian beach with free and paid sections.
spiaggia-di-finale-ligure.parking: Free roadside spots on Via Aurelia (about 40, noisy); paid parking at the beach for a small fee
spiaggia-di-finale-ligure.sunbeds: Paid sections rent umbrellas and loungers; free sections need your own umbrella.
spiaggia-di-finale-ligure.note: Calm sea, good for all-day stays.

platja-de-cadaques.access: Parking in town is limited; Platja del Ros has a free parking area nearby.
platja-de-cadaques.parking: Limited in town; free area near Platja del Ros
platja-de-cadaques.food: Bars and restaurants in Cadaques town; Platja del Ros has a bar and showers.
platja-de-cadaques.note: The town beach is small and central; sources on facilities for this exact beach are thin.

platja-de-calella-de-palafrugell.access: Public car parks near the beaches were not found.
platja-de-calella-de-palafrugell.food: Bars and restaurants on the promenade above Canadell; several restaurants at Les Voltes.
platja-de-calella-de-palafrugell.note: A cluster of small coves rather than one beach. The pebbly Golfet cove lies to the south toward Cap Roig.

platja-de-blanes.access: Central beach about 625 m long, from the port to Sa Palomera rock, the start of the Costa Brava.
platja-de-blanes.parking: Saba underground car park on Passeig de Mar, a few metres from the sand.
platja-de-blanes.note: Blue Flag, lifeguards, showers, toilets and accessible access. Lifeguard figures found are old.

platja-de-salou.access: Llevant beach about 1.2 km long with a ramp for reduced mobility.
platja-de-salou.parking: 522 surface spaces on Passeig Jaume I (2021) plus underground car parks.
platja-de-salou.sunbeds: Sunbed hire available on the beach.
platja-de-salou.food: Nine chiringuitos on Llevant, plus restaurants behind the beach.
platja-de-salou.note: Lifeguard and first aid posts and a children play area.

platja-del-regueral-cambrils.access: Prat d en Fores-Regueral stretch of about 937 m with step-free access and amphibious chairs.
platja-del-regueral-cambrils.note: Lifeguard and first aid. Blue Flag.

playa-de-la-rada-estepona.access: Easy; flat beach beside the promenade.
playa-de-la-rada-estepona.parking: Two large underground car parks; street parking can be busy
playa-de-la-rada-estepona.sunbeds: Sunbed rental points; some chiringuitos give free loungers with a meal.
playa-de-la-rada-estepona.food: Chiringuitos along the seafront serving espetos and paella.
playa-de-la-rada-estepona.note: Lifeguard and rental points usually run from 10:00 until late in high season. Old coast road is closed to vehicles.

playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.access: San Cristobal beach about 1 km by 45 m, reached from the town.
playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.parking: Parking fills quickly; street plus underground car parks.
playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.sunbeds: Sunbed and parasol hire, plus pedalos.
playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.food: Many chiringuitos and restaurants along the beach.
playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.note: Lifeguards and showers. Blue Flag status reported inconsistently.

plage-du-touquet.sunbeds: Private beach clubs rent mattresses and umbrellas.
plage-du-touquet.food: Cafes and restaurants along the front.
plage-du-touquet.note: Sand yachting is a signature activity. Lifeguards in peak season. Beach length reports vary.

plage-de-collioure.access: Parking is the main problem; a limited lot on the south side of the bay. Arrive early in high season.
plage-de-collioure.parking: Very limited; arrive early or park in town
plage-de-collioure.sunbeds: Mattress rental at neighbouring Plage Saint-Vincent.
plage-de-collioure.food: Seaside restaurants near the beach; reviews are mixed on value.
plage-de-collioure.note: Pebble beach between the church and the Royal Castle. Saint-Vincent next door has toilets, a restaurant and a lifeguard in season.

plage-de-cavaliere-le-lavandou.parking: Paid public car park with 200 spaces about 300 m away; authorised spots on Avenue du Cap Negre
plage-de-cavaliere-le-lavandou.sunbeds: Sunbed rental by concessions; free access overall.
plage-de-cavaliere-le-lavandou.food: Restaurant Plage du Layet Chez Jo and beach restaurants.
plage-de-cavaliere-le-lavandou.note: Lifeguarded early June to mid-September. Windsurf and kitesurf. Reviews note crowding and no showers.

plage-de-cabourg.access: Long central sandy beach in front of the Marcel Proust promenade (3.6 km).
plage-de-cabourg.parking: Hard in summer: casino car park, avenue du Commandant Touchard, avenue de la Mer.
plage-de-cabourg.sunbeds: Cabins and deckchairs for rent; book ahead.
plage-de-cabourg.food: Cafes and restaurants on the promenade.

spiaggia-di-punta-ala.access: Equipped beach clubs and free stretches; Cala Violina is a separate free beach 1.8 to 2 km on foot through pine woods
spiaggia-di-punta-ala.parking: Cala Violina car park off the SP158 (about km 10); check season rules with the municipality
spiaggia-di-punta-ala.sunbeds: Not confirmed; the PuntAla Camp resort has its own beach club for guests.
spiaggia-di-punta-ala.food: Nearby restaurants include Bernardo and Yacht Club Punta Ala.
spiaggia-di-punta-ala.note: Cala Violina has no beach clubs and one summer kiosk, and access rules can change, so check with the Castiglione della Pescaia municipality before going.

sidari-beach.access: Flat, long sandy bay; the Canal d Amour is close.
sidari-beach.parking: Nearby parking; arrive early in peak season
sidari-beach.note: Blue Flag. Water sports such as banana boats and water skiing. Packed in peak season.

porec-beach.access: Resort coast with sheltered coves; Zelena Laguna is paved, pebble and rocky, Blue Flag, with a separate naturist area.
porec-beach.parking: Plenty of spaces near the resort beaches; Plava Laguna allows parking in forest shade; fees not confirmed.
porec-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent at Zelena Laguna.
porec-beach.food: Resort restaurants and bars; Brulo has showers, changing stands and pine shade.
porec-beach.note: Use sea shoes as entrances can be stony.

praia-da-costa-da-caparica.access: Long flat beach strip; the Transpraia train status is uncertain (check locally).
praia-da-costa-da-caparica.parking: Parking at most beaches; outdoor parking listed
praia-da-costa-da-caparica.sunbeds: Sunshade rental; sunbeds about EUR 15 reported at Nova Vaga.
praia-da-costa-da-caparica.food: Ocean Beach Bar, Praia Princesa Beach Club and seafood places on Rua dos Pescadores.
praia-da-costa-da-caparica.note: Lifeguards during the summer season in daylight hours. Southern beaches are quieter.

hersonissos-beach.access: Series of small town beaches with the best organised in front of Silva Maris.
hersonissos-beach.food: Food and water nearby; tavernas around the harbour.
hersonissos-beach.note: Lifeguards, showers and Blue Flag at some beaches; check the flag. Lifeguard cover is thin on quieter stretches.

playa-de-moraira.access: El Portet is a sheltered cove.
playa-de-moraira.parking: Parking is limited; arrive early or pay
playa-de-moraira.food: Chiringuitos such as El Raco and restaurants.
playa-de-moraira.note: Blue Flag. Lifeguards in summer, kayak hire.

plage-de-saint-aygulf-frejus.parking: Paid parking at Esclamandes; free lots reported nearby but fill fast
plage-de-saint-aygulf-frejus.note: Esclamandes has four zones: family, naturist, kitesurf and dog. Showers, toilets and lifeguards in season.

praia-da-povoa-de-varzim.access: Praia da Baleia and Estela area; free beach wheelchairs at lifeguard stations.
praia-da-povoa-de-varzim.parking: Free street spots plus a paid lot with 200+ spaces about 3 minutes away.
praia-da-povoa-de-varzim.food: Restaurants such as Farol da Povoa nearby.

platja-de-roses.parking: Free and paid parking nearby; paid mainly in high season
platja-de-roses.sunbeds: Sun lounger hire at neighbouring Salatar and Rastrell; main beach not confirmed.

playa-de-levante-santa-pola.access: Urban beach more than 400 m long in the Llevant area, with promenade access.
playa-de-levante-santa-pola.parking: Parking listed among services; capacity not confirmed.
playa-de-levante-santa-pola.note: Lifeguards and toilets listed by regional tourism.

playa-de-gandia.access: Wide urban beach with a promenade; holds a long Blue Flag record.
playa-de-gandia.parking: Parking listed among services; capacity not confirmed.
playa-de-gandia.food: Beach bars and beach clubs along the shore.
playa-de-gandia.note: Lifeguards on duty in season. Showers available.

playa-san-antonio-cullera.access: Sant Antoni beach, the busiest and most awarded in Cullera, with accessible entrances, ramps and amphibious chairs.
playa-san-antonio-cullera.parking: Paid parking near the Sant Antoni promenade about 3 EUR per day in summer, arrive before 10:00 in August; spaces for reduced mobility.
playa-san-antonio-cullera.note: Lifeguards in high season. Shade, water sports and taxi stops.

platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.access: About 2,000 m of fine golden sand with adapted parking and a bus stop.
platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.parking: Car park, adapted parking and bicycle parking.
platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.sunbeds: Hammocks and sunbeds reported; prices not confirmed.
platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.food: Beach bar and restaurant on site.
platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.note: Lifeguard tower and Red Cross post. Storm erosion has left stones on parts of the shore.

torrevieja-beach.access: Playa del Cura is an urban beach of about 375 to 600 m with Blue Flag and accessible access.
torrevieja-beach.parking: Parking is hard in high season; a large lot to the north of the town; arrive early.
torrevieja-beach.food: A row of chiringuitos serving drinks and tapas.
torrevieja-beach.note: Lifeguards, showers and a beach volleyball court. Parking fills on weekends in August.

playa-del-moncayo-guardamar.parking: Easy to find a space early in summer; some car parks may charge
playa-del-moncayo-guardamar.food: Some chiringuito beach bars in summer.
playa-del-moncayo-guardamar.note: Blue Flag. Lifeguards, toilets, rinsing taps and boardwalks.

playa-de-mojacar.parking: Roadside parking near the shore; fills in peak summer
playa-de-mojacar.food: Chiringuitos at nearby Cantal and Marina de la Torre.
playa-de-mojacar.note: Lifeguard on this beach not confirmed.

platja-de-pineda-de-mar.access: Pineda de Mar main beach La Riera, Blue Flag, with a Passeig Maritim.
platja-de-pineda-de-mar.parking: Free surface lot of about 150 spaces on Passeig Maritim except in August; paid motorhome area of about 30 spaces; blue-zone in the centre.
platja-de-pineda-de-mar.food: Chiringuito such as Sa Closca and Santis Beach Bar.
platja-de-pineda-de-mar.note: Lifeguards and showers. Verify details with the town council.

platja-de-malgrat-de-mar.access: Long sandy beach split into Centre and Sud sectors.
platja-de-malgrat-de-mar.parking: Free municipal car park of about 300 spaces by Passeig Maritim at Centre; about 100 free surface spaces at Sud.
platja-de-malgrat-de-mar.sunbeds: Parasol and lounger hire reported at Lastillero only.
platja-de-malgrat-de-mar.note: Lifeguards, showers and accessible access at Centre.

plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.access: Plage du Roussillon and Plage de la Jetee with accessible facilities and free beach wheelchairs.
plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.parking: Several lots and street parking; they can fill up in peak season.
plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.sunbeds: Lounge chairs, mats and umbrellas rented; costs apply.
plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.food: Beach restaurants nearby; paillote details not confirmed.
plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.note: Swimming supervised 7 June to 7 September, 10:30-18:30, with a first aid post.

ile-de-batz-beach-roscoff.access: Ferry from Roscoff with Les Vedettes de l Ile de Batz: about 15 minutes, with roughly 7 to 8 departures a day on the 2026 timetable (adult fare about EUR 11). Check summer times before you go.
ile-de-batz-beach-roscoff.parking: Leave the car on the mainland at Roscoff; on the island hire a bike at the port (Velos Le Saout).
ile-de-batz-beach-roscoff.food: Bar-restaurant beside the Embarcadere beach and a small cafe at Porz an Illiz next to the Georges Delaselle garden; bring a picnic as a back-up.
ile-de-batz-beach-roscoff.note: There is little shade at Porz Melloc, so bring a hat. Tickets are sold at the harbour or on board.

spiaggia-di-pescara.access: Long sand city beach with lidi along Lungomare Matteotti and free equipped areas.
spiaggia-di-pescara.parking: Parking at some lidi such as Zara; public lots not confirmed.
spiaggia-di-pescara.sunbeds: Lidi rent loungers and umbrellas; Playa Maria is a free equipped beach.
spiaggia-di-pescara.food: Beach bars and restaurants at lidi.
spiaggia-di-pescara.note: Lifeguards at lidi cover adjacent free beaches.

spiaggia-di-punta-aderci-vasto.access: Free parking nearby, then a long coastal path with sea views to the beach. A shuttle may run in season.
spiaggia-di-punta-aderci-vasto.parking: Free parking near the reserve; best at the eastern end by Porto di Vasto
spiaggia-di-punta-aderci-vasto.food: No restaurant on the beach; a snack corner at nearby Punta Penna and restaurants in Vasto.
spiaggia-di-punta-aderci-vasto.note: Inside the Punta Aderci nature reserve; bring food, water and an umbrella. Part of the Costa dei Trabocchi cycle path.

spiaggia-di-varazze.access: Mix of paid lidos and free beaches along the seafront near the old town and marina.
spiaggia-di-varazze.parking: Paid and free parking in some areas; lido parking is often reserved for customers.
spiaggia-di-varazze.sunbeds: Umbrella plus two loungers from about 15 EUR at lidos.
spiaggia-di-varazze.food: Many bars and restaurants near the old town.
spiaggia-di-varazze.note: 42 lidos in total; train station is near the beaches.

spiaggia-grande-diamante.access: Flat town beach beside the new promenade.
spiaggia-grande-diamante.sunbeds: Lidos along the front rent umbrellas and sunbeds (for example L Altro Lato and La Voce del Mare).
spiaggia-grande-diamante.food: Lido restaurants and bars serving Calabrian dishes.
spiaggia-grande-diamante.note: Details for this exact beach are thin; several lidos operate along the coast.

kardamena-beach-kos.access: Long sandy beach right in the town of Kardamena.
kardamena-beach-kos.parking: Free parking on public streets; beach parking hard to find.
kardamena-beach-kos.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas about 8 EUR per set at one beach bar, free with a meal; a quieter stretch next door has no loungers.
kardamena-beach-kos.food: Beach bars, tavernas, cafes and cocktail bars.

malia-beach-crete.access: Wide sand beach, usually very crowded, with quieter Potamos Beach nearby.
malia-beach-crete.parking: Parking along the beachfront road and side streets; fills in peak summer, arrive before 10:00.
malia-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds about 3 to 25 EUR for two reported; much of the sand is held by hotels and bars. Bring your own parasol to use free areas.
malia-beach-crete.food: Tavernas and bars a short walk away.
malia-beach-crete.note: Lifeguards, showers and Blue Flag listed.

vodice-beach.access: Srima beach is newly renovated and Blue Flag, reached on foot via the coastal promenade or by car.
vodice-beach.food: Bars and snack bars near Srima centre.
vodice-beach.note: Showers and changing rooms. Gentle shallow entry suits children.

praia-atlantica-troia.access: Ferries run from Setubal (about EUR 9-10 return, reported); you can also take a car on the car ferry.
praia-atlantica-troia.food: A small beach bar nearby; restaurants within a few minutes walk.
praia-atlantica-troia.note: Lifeguards on the Troia beaches in season (reported).

praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.access: On the Arrabida coast road from Setubal, with a bus stop at the beach; summer car restrictions apply under Arrabida sem Carros.
praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.parking: Small paid lot in the bathing season that fills up in summer; one reviewer advises going by bike or bus.
praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.sunbeds: Sun loungers and umbrella rental in season; lifeguards, toilets and showers.
praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.food: Bar Mar and Figueirinha Beach Lounge is on the beach, with a terrace and Portuguese seafood dishes, open all year.
praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.note: Arrive by bus or bike in July and August and check the current car rules.

praia-de-espinho.access: Wide Atlantic beach in front of Espinho town, about 20 km south of Porto on the Porto-Aveiro railway line.
praia-de-espinho.parking: Parking details for the central beach not confirmed; the Praia Azul stretch lists a car park.
praia-de-espinho.food: Seafront restaurants and bars in town; Praia Seca lists a bar and sun loungers.
praia-de-espinho.note: Supervised beaches in season, with 1.6 km of coast covered when the season was extended. Sand is deep, which can be hard for reduced mobility.

arvanitia-beach-nafplio.access: Large car park up the road by the Land Gate, then steps down to the beach; a flat path leads on to Karathona.
arvanitia-beach-nafplio.sunbeds: Rented sun umbrellas and deck chairs.
arvanitia-beach-nafplio.food: A cafeteria on the beach (older listings).
arvanitia-beach-nafplio.note: Pebbles in the centre, rocky edges with small metal ladders. Showers and WC. Early or late is best for the Karathona walk in summer.

plage-de-la-grande-motte.access: Public free beaches (Point Zero, Couchant, Ponant, Grand Travers); two paid private beaches.
plage-de-la-grande-motte.parking: Free car park with shade less than 10 minutes on foot from the marina.
plage-de-la-grande-motte.sunbeds: Cocobaie and La Voile Bleue are paid beach clubs; the Plage des Bikinis bar also has loungers.
plage-de-la-grande-motte.food: Harbour restaurants such as Le Poseidon.
plage-de-la-grande-motte.note: Crowded in summer, especially near restaurants and late in the day.

cavtat-beach.access: Easy; at the end of the promenade in Tiha Bay.
cavtat-beach.parking: Parking hard to find near the beaches
cavtat-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds for rent; about EUR 15 for two and an umbrella (reported).
cavtat-beach.food: Several bars, cafes and restaurants close by.
cavtat-beach.note: Pebbles can be slippery, so water shoes help. Cash is useful.

plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.access: Paid car park right by the beach (about 259 spaces, EUR 2.20 per hour, free November-February, reported).
plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.parking: Paid car park by the beach, about EUR 2.20 per hour
plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.sunbeds: One private beach club rents sunbeds; the rest of the beach is free.
plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.food: Restaurants along the promenade and at the beach club.
plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.note: Public toilets and showers. Lifeguard season reported as mid-June to mid-September by one source and July-August by another.

perivolos-beach-santorini.access: Easy; long flat black sand beach.
perivolos-beach-santorini.parking: Generous roadside parking; no fee confirmed
perivolos-beach-santorini.sunbeds: Beach bars rent sunbed sets; packages often include drinks or food and vary widely.
perivolos-beach-santorini.food: Beach bars and restaurants such as FortyOne.
perivolos-beach-santorini.note: Black volcanic sand gets very hot. Water shoes are useful.

georgioupoli-beach-crete.access: Long flat beach beside the village.
georgioupoli-beach-crete.parking: Parking near the beach and along roads into town; fills by mid-morning in July and August
georgioupoli-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas, often offered by tavernas at little or no charge.
georgioupoli-beach-crete.food: Tavernas and snack bars along the sand and in the village.
georgioupoli-beach-crete.note: Lifeguards usually on duty because currents can be strong. Water sports available.

elounda-beach-crete.access: Flat beach; Spinalonga boats leave from the harbour.
elounda-beach-crete.parking: Parking at the beach fills in July and August; park slightly outside the centre if needed
elounda-beach-crete.food: A taverna on the beach; Elounda restaurants such as Lotus Eaters and Olondi.

kolymbia-beach-rhodes.access: Long main beach of sand and pebble, plus a small harbour beach of sand and shingle.
kolymbia-beach-rhodes.food: A handful of traditional tavernas near the harbour; shops in the resort centre.
kolymbia-beach-rhodes.note: Harbour almost enclosed by volcanic rock.

kamenjak-beach-premantura.access: Free for walkers and cyclists; cars pay a day pass (about EUR 10-15, sources disagree). Buses 26 and 28 run via Pula bus station.
kamenjak-beach-premantura.parking: Car day pass about EUR 10-15; free lot before the gate
kamenjak-beach-premantura.food: Safari bar near Mala Kolombarica; some beach bars take cash only.
kamenjak-beach-premantura.note: Protected cape about 10 km from Pula.

praia-do-martinhal-sagres.access: Short walk from free and paid parking; free spots fill early in high season.
praia-do-martinhal-sagres.parking: Free and paid parking; free spots fill early
praia-do-martinhal-sagres.note: Lifeguards in summer; shallow entry suits children. Sources disagree on beach length.

praia-da-conceicao-cascais.access: Easy; small central cove with an amphibious chair for reduced mobility.
praia-da-conceicao-cascais.parking: Use a designated car park in central Cascais and walk; tight in peak season
praia-da-conceicao-cascais.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas rent in pairs; about EUR 45 for two plus umbrella (one blog, may be dated).
praia-da-conceicao-cascais.food: Restaurant, bar and promenade cafes; Emma Beach Club nearby.
praia-da-conceicao-cascais.note: Lifeguard and first-aid post in bathing season. Seating is first come, first served.

praia-de-supertubos-peniche.access: Beach on the N144 about 2 km from Peniche; also reachable on foot via a bridge.
praia-de-supertubos-peniche.parking: Car park at the beach; a free spot at nearby Consolacao
praia-de-supertubos-peniche.food: Bar, restaurant and Banana Beach Bar nearby.
praia-de-supertubos-peniche.note: Supervised in summer. Several surf schools nearby. Also called Praia Medao.

praia-da-marina-vilamoura.access: Easy; short walk from the marina.
praia-da-marina-vilamoura.parking: Small lot beside the beach; walk from the marina in summer
praia-da-marina-vilamoura.food: Beachfront bars and cafes; more in Vilamoura Marina.
praia-da-marina-vilamoura.note: Lifeguards in summer. Crowded in August; calmer in June.

praia-da-alagoa-altura.access: Easy; wooden walkway from the car park to the sand.
praia-da-alagoa-altura.food: Beach bar and about nine restaurants nearby.
praia-da-alagoa-altura.note: Lifeguards in season and toilets. Sources disagree on the municipality.

plage-de-biscarrosse.access: Easy; pedestrian street to the sand at Plage Centrale.
plage-de-biscarrosse.parking: Free parking along Boulevard des Sables
plage-de-biscarrosse.food: Restaurants, bar and bike rental in the centre; restaurant and surf school at Plage Sud.
plage-de-biscarrosse.note: Lifeguards 11:00-19:00 in high season (about 4 July to 30 August in 2026). Toilets and showers. Plage Sud has facilities for reduced mobility.

plage-de-carnac.parking: Roadside parking along the beach access road; free and paid reported
plage-de-carnac.sunbeds: Deckchairs, beach tents and pedal boats for rent in summer.
plage-de-carnac.food: A bar on the beach and terraces along the shore.
plage-de-carnac.note: Blue Flag. Supervised in summer, with a children s club, showers, toilets and accessible equipment.

playa-de-samil.food: Beach kiosks; four of Vigo's eleven are at Samil.
playa-de-samil.note: Red Cross lifeguard post in bathing season. Blue Flag reported as lost after water analyses (March 2026 report).

playa-de-la-fontanilla.access: Parking at the end of the access road from El Roqueo street; arrive after about 2 pm for easier parking.
playa-de-la-fontanilla.parking: At the end of El Roqueo access road; easier after 2 pm
playa-de-la-fontanilla.sunbeds: Sun loungers and parasols for hire in summer.
playa-de-la-fontanilla.food: Three chiringuitos by the water, usually open all summer.
playa-de-la-fontanilla.note: Lifeguards, showers and toilets in summer. The toilets sit by the car park. Width changes with tides.

playa-de-trafalgar.access: About 10 km from Barbate to the Trafalgar lighthouse beach near Los Canos de Meca.
playa-de-trafalgar.parking: Very limited in summer: one visitor parked at the far end of the village and walked about 45 minutes. Arrive early.
playa-de-trafalgar.food: Restaurants and open-air cafes on the slope above the beach, with sea views.
playa-de-trafalgar.note: A popular sunset spot; check parking rules with Barbate council.

playa-de-san-juan.access: Easy; step-free access near point 10 (July 1 to September 15).
playa-de-san-juan.parking: Paid parking behind the promenade; regulated street parking in summer
playa-de-san-juan.note: Foot showers, lifeguard and first aid. Free entry.

spiaggia-di-maria-pia-alghero.access: Beach beside a pine forest, in the city of Alghero.
spiaggia-di-maria-pia-alghero.parking: Mostly paid in July and August (about EUR 1.50 per hour or EUR 10 per day); free spots easier in shoulder months
spiaggia-di-maria-pia-alghero.sunbeds: Loungers and parasols for rent; about EUR 45 for two in the first row (reported).
spiaggia-di-maria-pia-alghero.note: Pines give natural shade. Free areas exist as well.

spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.access: Long sandy beach split into numbered lido sections (ufficio spiaggia).
spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.parking: Some lots charge a fee and others are free; arrive early in peak season.
spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.sunbeds: Umbrella plus two sunbeds about 10 to 22 EUR at 43 lidos.
spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.note: Lifeguard availability varies by section; check your lido.

platja-de-sant-feliu-de-guixols.access: Easy; central beach with adapted access and an amphibious chair.
platja-de-sant-feliu-de-guixols.parking: Parking area listed; capacity not confirmed
platja-de-sant-feliu-de-guixols.note: Blue Flag and lifeguard. Smoke-free zone in the south; the north side near the port is not for swimming. Busy because of its central location.

plage-des-sables-blancs-concarneau.access: Family beach; the northern part is the most pleasant.
plage-des-sables-blancs-concarneau.parking: Free parking near the beach; some paid
plage-des-sables-blancs-concarneau.food: Restaurants and cafes nearby, several about 3 minutes by car.
plage-des-sables-blancs-concarneau.note: Supervised in July and August. Dogs are not allowed.

stavros-beach-crete.access: About 15 km from Chania on the Akrotiri peninsula, roughly 25 to 30 minutes by car; buses from Chania run in summer on a limited schedule.
stavros-beach-crete.parking: Free car park just behind the shore that fills in July and August; arrive before 10am or after 4pm.
stavros-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for hire along the main section (one visitor found them pricey).
stavros-beach-crete.food: Tavernas behind the beach in summer; sources differ on how many.
stavros-beach-crete.note: A sheltered, shallow bay that suits small children. The final dance scene of Zorba the Greek was filmed here.

plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.access: Easy; flat beach by the town centre.
plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.parking: Many places to park in the centre; small car park at Plage Sud
plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.food: Restaurants open in the centre in summer.
plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.note: Lifeguard post opposite the esplanade in summer. Plage Nord is unsupervised. Toilets and showers at Plage Sud.

playa-de-la-herradura.access: Easy; flat dark sand and pebble beach, about 2 km long.
playa-de-la-herradura.parking: Pay-and-display parking on the beachfront; over 100 spaces reported
playa-de-la-herradura.food: Chiringuitos serving local fish and seafood.
playa-de-la-herradura.note: Lifeguards and showers reported. Not a Blue Flag beach. Bus 2B from Almunecar.

selce-beach-crikvenica.access: Partly concrete beach near Hotel Slaven, with small pebble coves nearby.
selce-beach-crikvenica.food: Restaurants such as Sidro, Caffe Bonino and Konoba Toc within about 15 minutes on foot.
selce-beach-crikvenica.note: Diving centre and water sports nearby.

playa-de-la-victoria-cadiz.access: Long flat city beach with a promenade.
playa-de-la-victoria-cadiz.parking: Street parking in surrounding streets; hard at peak times
playa-de-la-victoria-cadiz.sunbeds: Chiringuitos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; paddle boats.
playa-de-la-victoria-cadiz.food: Several chiringuitos line the back of the beach.

skala-beach-kefalonia.access: Easy; long beach along the coast road.
skala-beach-kefalonia.parking: Ample parking near the main beach; crowded in peak season
skala-beach-kefalonia.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for hire along most of the beach.
skala-beach-kefalonia.food: Many bars and tavernas on the coast road.
skala-beach-kefalonia.note: Lifeguard in summer (one guide); other sources disagree.

agnontas-beach-skopelos.parking: Street parking; public lot not confirmed
agnontas-beach-skopelos.sunbeds: No rental confirmed; nearby beaches have loungers.
agnontas-beach-skopelos.food: Three fish tavernas on the sand; lobster spaghetti is the local dish.
agnontas-beach-skopelos.note: Pebble and sand beach beside a working harbour. Limnonari is about 1.5 km away.

stegna-beach-rhodes.access: Sand and pebble beach in Stegna village, reached directly from the village road.
stegna-beach-rhodes.parking: Free parking is mainly tied to nearby accommodation; public beach parking not confirmed.
stegna-beach-rhodes.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent along the organised stretch.
stegna-beach-rhodes.food: Local tavernas and cafes behind the beach; Taverna Mavrios is often cited nearby, many serve fresh seafood.
stegna-beach-rhodes.note: Clear shallow water. Prices and opening hours not confirmed.

marmari-beach-kos.access: Long beach about 14 km from Kos Town, reached easily by frequent bus.
marmari-beach-kos.parking: Free parking next to the beach reported by reviewers.
marmari-beach-kos.sunbeds: Sunbed with umbrella about 5 EUR per person (10 EUR per couple) reported; some bars give them free with an order.
marmari-beach-kos.food: Seaside tavernas, cafes and cocktail bars along the waterfront.
marmari-beach-kos.note: Known for wind, with several kite and windsurf clubs offering lessons and gear.

glystra-beach-rhodes.access: Reached from Lardos or Lindos by road; path details not found.
glystra-beach-rhodes.sunbeds: Sources disagree; availability uncertain after the 2023 wildfires.
glystra-beach-rhodes.food: A small taverna serves drinks and snacks.
glystra-beach-rhodes.note: Amenities may have changed since the 2023 wildfires. Check recent reports.

spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.access: Easy; flat 8 km beach. Buses PF and PQ from central Cagliari about every 10 minutes (about EUR 1.30).
spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.parking: Large lots that fill up; hippodrome lot reported EUR 1 per hour or EUR 10 per day (rates may be dated)
spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.sunbeds: Sunbed and umbrella sets about EUR 24-35 (reported); free sections too.
spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.food: Bars, kiosks, food trucks and restaurants along the beach.
spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.note: Lifeguards reported. Split between free and paid concession areas.

spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.access: Fine-sand beach about 1.5 km long and 200 m wide, reached from the seafront promenade.
spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.parking: Beach parking not confirmed; check streets near the lungomare.
spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.sunbeds: Many equipped lidi rent sunbeds, umbrellas and cabins; unequipped free areas also exist.
spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.note: Blue Flag for water and service quality. Showers at the lidi.

spiaggia-di-portonovo.access: From Ancona by the Conero Link bus (about EUR 1.35, sold with the train ticket) or by car to a large paid lot with a free shuttle in summer.
spiaggia-di-portonovo.parking: Large lot reported at EUR 8 a day in peak season and EUR 5 off-peak, with a free shuttle every 15 to 20 minutes; check current prices.
spiaggia-di-portonovo.sunbeds: Beach establishments (lidos) operate in season; confirm sunbed prices locally.
spiaggia-di-portonovo.food: Lido restaurants serve seafood; try the local mussels (moscioli) at lunch.
spiaggia-di-portonovo.note: Go early in the morning or late in the afternoon; July and August are very crowded.

spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.access: Flat bay of about 2 km between Avola and Siracusa.
spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.parking: Ample; free about a 10-15 minute walk away, or paid lots
spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.sunbeds: Concessions rent an umbrella and two loungers for about EUR 25-30 per day.
spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.food: Lido bars and restaurants such as Lido Sayonara.
spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.note: About 90 percent is private concessions; the free stretch is small and may have no showers or changing room. Seaweed at times.

baska-voda-beach.access: Easy; pebble beach along the promenade.
baska-voda-beach.parking: Metered street parking and lots in town; rates near the beach can be high
baska-voda-beach.food: Cafes, bars and restaurants on the waterfront promenade.
baska-voda-beach.note: Blue Flag, restrooms and showers. Try prsut and black risotto locally.

bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.access: Short walk or drive from Lumbarda; shallow sandy cove among vineyards.
bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.parking: Small free lot beside the beach; few spaces, fills in peak season
bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.food: A small beach bar or restaurant on the sand (reports vary).
bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.note: Do not confuse with Bili Zal at Przina. Shallow water suits families.

lovran-beach.access: Town beaches on the Lungomare promenade: Peharovo is pebble, the city beach is part paved and part pebble.
lovran-beach.parking: Public parking along the Lungomare not confirmed; nearby Medveja charges about 2 to 3 EUR per hour or 15 EUR per day.
lovran-beach.sunbeds: Not confirmed; mostly paved and pebble sunbathing areas.
lovran-beach.food: Cafes and restaurants beside the beach, from simple bistros to beachfront dining.
lovran-beach.note: Walk the Lungomare for more coves. Bring water shoes for the pebbles.

opatija-beach.access: Slatina is the main town beach, with a concrete sunbathing area and a sandy section.
opatija-beach.parking: Car park of about 50 spaces reported near Slatina.
opatija-beach.sunbeds: Loungers and umbrellas for rent; reviewers mention high fees and no natural shade.
opatija-beach.food: Beach bars and restaurants right behind Slatina, plus ice cream parlours and kiosks.
opatija-beach.note: Lido beach in Volosko is concrete with steps into the water, a bar and a restaurant.

playa-de-matalascanas.access: Long Atlantic sand beach in the resort of Matalascanas, gets crowded in peak summer.
playa-de-matalascanas.parking: Beach car park capacity and fees not confirmed.
playa-de-matalascanas.note: Lifeguards and showers; Blue Flag awarded regularly.

playa-de-islantilla.access: Beach runs the length of the resort town with wheelchair access.
playa-de-islantilla.parking: Parking reported by one secondary source; capacity and fees not confirmed.
playa-de-islantilla.sunbeds: Parasols and sun loungers for rent along the beach.
playa-de-islantilla.food: Several chiringuito beach bars serve food and drinks through the day.
playa-de-islantilla.note: Lifeguards in the bathing season, toilets and showers depending on time of year. Blue Flag.

playa-de-regla-chipiona.access: Playa de Regla in Chipiona, Blue Flag beach with accessible access.
playa-de-regla-chipiona.parking: A parking zone exists; in July and August arrive before 10:00.
playa-de-regla-chipiona.food: Many bars and chiringuitos around the beach.
playa-de-regla-chipiona.note: Lifeguards, showers, toilets and a Red Cross post. Children area. Length reported 1.2 to 1.455 km.

playa-paraiso-villajoyosa.access: Beach reached by tram line 1 or by car.
playa-paraiso-villajoyosa.parking: Large car park, but reviewers report police ticketing and a stony access road
playa-paraiso-villajoyosa.food: Two beach bars open in summer.
playa-paraiso-villajoyosa.note: Lifeguards, showers, toilets and disabled access. Campervans and pets are not allowed.

praia-grande-ferragudo.access: Easy; wide sandy beach near the village.
praia-grande-ferragudo.parking: Outdoor municipal parking; arrive early or walk from the village
praia-grande-ferragudo.sunbeds: Sunshades for rent, about EUR 20 for two beds and umbrella (reported).
praia-grande-ferragudo.food: Praia Grande restaurant (closes about 7 pm) and Club Nau (open late).
praia-grande-ferragudo.note: Lifeguards about 1 June to 30 September. Showers and changing areas.

praia-da-barra-aveiro.access: Wide Atlantic beach beside the Barra lighthouse, the tallest in Portugal at 62 m.
praia-da-barra-aveiro.food: More restaurants and accommodation than neighbouring Costa Nova, which is known for seafood.
praia-da-barra-aveiro.note: Lifeguard schedule not found; check locally.

vila-nova-de-milfontes-beach.access: Sheltered river side and rougher Atlantic side; currents near the river bar.
vila-nova-de-milfontes-beach.food: A Choupana restaurant on the beach, busy at lunch.
vila-nova-de-milfontes-beach.note: Rescuers and first aid listed; confirm lifeguard hours.

praia-dos-olhos-de-agua.parking: Paid parking at the entrance with limited spaces; street parking nearby
praia-dos-olhos-de-agua.food: Seafront restaurants such as La Cigale.
praia-dos-olhos-de-agua.note: Blue Flag listed and lifeguards in season. Crowded from July to mid-September.

plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.parking: Street parking along the beach and a small free lot nearby
plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.sunbeds: No rental confirmed; bathing cabins at both ends.
plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.food: Restaurants along the promenade; creperie at the campsite.
plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.note: Supervised in summer, children club, showers and toilets. Dogs not allowed. Casino and cinema nearby.

plage-du-trez-benodet.access: Easy; beach lift and Handiplage label.
plage-du-trez-benodet.parking: Car park listed; location and fees not confirmed
plage-du-trez-benodet.sunbeds: Beach huts for hire via the town hall.
plage-du-trez-benodet.food: Bars and restaurants a stone throw away; no beach snack bar found.
plage-du-trez-benodet.note: Blue Flag since 2024. Lifeguards (CRS) 12:00-19:00 in July and August. Free showers and toilets.

plage-de-mimizan.access: Wide Atlantic beaches of the Landes coast; Plage Sud is next to the lifeguard post on Avenue de l Ocean.
plage-de-mimizan.parking: Free parking on Avenue de l Ocean near the lifeguard post; free lot at Lespecier beside a bar.
plage-de-mimizan.food: Restaurants and a bar-restaurant at Plage Sud; seasonal food at Lespecier.
plage-de-mimizan.note: Plage Sud supervised 13 June to 13 September daily; supervision end dates differ by source.

plage-du-kelenn-carantec.access: Easy; tidal beach; Ile Callot is reached by a 900 m causeway at low tide only.
plage-du-kelenn-carantec.parking: Free car park; separate motorhome area
plage-du-kelenn-carantec.food: Brasserie Le Petit Relais on the beach; other restaurants near the church.
plage-du-kelenn-carantec.note: Lifeguard 12:00-19:00 from 3 July to 29 August (2026). Check tide times before crossing to Ile Callot.

elafonisi-beach-crete.access: By car from Chania (1.5 to 2 hours, narrow for the last 15 km), by seasonal bus or on an organised tour; from the car park it is about a 10 minute walk to the sand.
elafonisi-beach-crete.parking: Several paid lots along the road; most guides recommend the last, closest lot (about EUR 5 a day). Lots fill by 9am in July and August.
elafonisi-beach-crete.sunbeds: Paid sunbeds and umbrellas in season (one visitor reported about EUR 20 for two beds and an umbrella); they sell out by mid-morning, so bring your own umbrella.
elafonisi-beach-crete.food: Snack bar and small cafes by the parking area, with queues at lunchtime. Bring water and snacks.
elafonisi-beach-crete.note: Arrive before 9am in July and August. Some snack bars and sunbed stands are not open yet in May.

kokkari-beach-samos.access: Easy; village beach with a small headland.
kokkari-beach-samos.food: A beach bar and fish tavernas along the sand.
kokkari-beach-samos.note: Strong wind makes waves and choppy water; popular with windsurfers. Lemonakia nearby is calmer.

vatera-beach-lesbos.access: Longest beach on Lesbos (reported 7 to 8 km), roadside access along the shore.
vatera-beach-lesbos.parking: Park along the beach, with some shaded spots; some satnavs route onto unpaved roads.
vatera-beach-lesbos.sunbeds: Partly organised; some stretches have sunbeds and umbrellas, others are bring-your-own.
vatera-beach-lesbos.food: Tavernas, cafes and hotels along the coast.
vatera-beach-lesbos.note: Surface reported as sand, sand and pebbles or pebbles. Buses from Mytilene run rarely in summer.

spiaggia-di-vendicari.access: Four entrances to the reserve (Main, Calamosche, Eloro, Cittadella). Calamosche is about a 20 minute walk from the parking.
spiaggia-di-vendicari.parking: Paid parking at the entrances, about EUR 3-5 reported
spiaggia-di-vendicari.food: No food on the beaches; snacks at nearby agriturismi and restaurants in Noto.
spiaggia-di-vendicari.note: Reserve entry fee reported at about EUR 3-7 depending on the source. No showers on the beaches. Confirm current prices.

zlatni-rt-rovinj.access: Walk, cycle or take the forest park promenade; the park is a car-limited nature area.
zlatni-rt-rovinj.parking: Sources disagree: spaces in front of the park, or paid around EUR 7 per day with a 10-15 minute walk
zlatni-rt-rovinj.sunbeds: Beach bars rent loungers and parasols.
zlatni-rt-rovinj.food: Several beach bars in the park.
zlatni-rt-rovinj.note: Rocky platforms and pebbles in a pine and cypress forest park. No sand.

cikat-bay-losinj.access: Several inlets, some sandy; reached on foot from Mali Losinj or by hotel buses.
cikat-bay-losinj.parking: Parking directly on the beach (camping side) and near the hotels
cikat-bay-losinj.sunbeds: Sunbeds, umbrellas, paddleboards, kayaks and pedal boats for rent.
cikat-bay-losinj.food: Several bars and restaurants; one listing disagrees.
cikat-bay-losinj.note: Showers and changing rooms. Mostly pebbles.

ambrela-beach-verudela.access: Ambrela is a pebble beach with a Blue Flag and lifeguard, popular with families.
ambrela-beach-verudela.parking: Car park of about 100 spaces reported; arrive early as free parking nearby is scarce.
ambrela-beach-verudela.sunbeds: Deck chairs, umbrellas, loungers and pedalos for rent.
ambrela-beach-verudela.food: Two cafes and Ambrela Bistro and Beach Bar; reviewer reports cash only and high prices.
ambrela-beach-verudela.note: Shade just back from the beach. Showers and changing cabins. Jellyfish warnings reported.

playa-de-la-olla-altea.access: Easy; pebble beach reached from the promenade.
playa-de-la-olla-altea.parking: Reports conflict: one source lists a car park, another none; arrive early
playa-de-la-olla-altea.food: A cafe-bar on the sand and restaurants nearby.
playa-de-la-olla-altea.note: Lifeguards, toilets and cleaning service listed. One database rates cleanliness poor, so check recent reports.

playa-de-la-zurriola-san-sebastian.parking: Parking listed; no details on cost or capacity
playa-de-la-zurriola-san-sebastian.food: Cafes and bars near the beach.
playa-de-la-zurriola-san-sebastian.note: Lifeguards June 1 to September 30 (10:00-20:00). 24 hot showers and 536 lockers. Local surf club and four surf schools.

playa-de-bakio.access: Atlantic sand beach on the Basque coast with a local surf club and two surf schools.
