playa-de-bakio.parking: Roadside spots and large car parks near the beach; hard to find a space in summer, arrive before 10 am or after 4 pm.
playa-de-bakio.food: Chiringuito not confirmed; nearby cafes in the village.
playa-de-bakio.note: Lifeguard 11:00 to 20:00 in summer. Beach break with left and right waves.

praia-de-sesimbra.access: Easy; flat town beach along Avenida 25 de Abril.
praia-de-sesimbra.parking: Car park and many spots near the beach
praia-de-sesimbra.food: Many restaurants along the sand serving regional food.
praia-de-sesimbra.note: Guarded in season. Play area and volleyball. Sources disagree on showers.

praia-de-cacela-velha.access: About 45 minutes east of Faro and 15 minutes from Tavira. The beach is across the lagoon from the village: walk at low tide or take a boat from Fabrica.
praia-de-cacela-velha.parking: Parking near the village (reported free); parking at Fabrica for the boat is increasingly difficult.
praia-de-cacela-velha.food: Restaurants in the village; names and hours not confirmed.
praia-de-cacela-velha.note: Check tide times first. Bus 67 runs between Faro and Vila Real de Santo Antonio, with a walk of about 15 minutes from the stop.

portinho-da-arrabida.access: From 1 June to 15 September private cars are not allowed on the road to Portinho from about 7am to 7pm (residents, taxis, scooters and public transport excepted). Free summer shuttles and buses run from Setubal; check the current Arrabida sem Carros rules.
portinho-da-arrabida.parking: Parking is paid in the bathing season and very limited; the car ban exists because the roads are dead ends with few spaces.
portinho-da-arrabida.food: Restaurante Farol stands where the port area ends and the beach begins; it is one of the few places to eat in the park.
portinho-da-arrabida.note: Plan to arrive by shuttle, bus, bike or on foot in summer, and confirm the current hours of the traffic ban with Setubal council.

praia-grande-porto-covo.access: Easy; short walk from the car park.
praia-grande-porto-covo.parking: Very large car park right by the beach; no fee confirmed
praia-grande-porto-covo.food: Praia Grande Bar e Restaurante on the beach.
praia-grande-porto-covo.note: Blue Flag with a seasonal lifeguard. One of the busiest beaches of the region in high season.

plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.access: Mostly pebble beaches along the Baie des Anges, with free public beaches and paid private beach clubs.
plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.parking: Surface car park near Lenval beach off Boulevard Rene Cassin; tariffs not confirmed.
plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.sunbeds: Private beaches rent loungers; Beau Rivage has a free public part and a paid part with service.
plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.food: Private beaches are usually tied to a restaurant or bar.
plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.note: Source counts differ: about 20 to 30 free public beaches and about 15 private ones. Showers and toilets at public beaches.

plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.access: Central family beach with sand, pebbles and gravel.
plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.parking: Mimosas car park about five minutes walk away; parking near the beach can be expensive
plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.sunbeds: Le Grand Large runs a private sunbed section in summer.
plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.food: Restaurants, bars and snack bars on the quays.
plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.note: Showers, toilets, lifeguard post and pedalo, kayak and windsurf rentals. Lifeguards mid-June to mid-September.

plage-notre-dame-porquerolles.access: Ferry from La Tour Fondue (Giens) in about 20 minutes, every 30 to 45 minutes in summer; a few crossings leave from Hyeres. There are no cars on Porquerolles, so rent a bike at the port or walk.
plage-notre-dame-porquerolles.parking: No cars on the island. On the mainland the Tour Fondue car park fills in July and August and is capped at about EUR 21 a day; a free car park near Hyeres port has a summer shuttle to the ferry.
plage-notre-dame-porquerolles.food: No shops at the beach, so buy supplies before you cross. Cafes and restaurants are in the village by the port, and the nearby Plage d Argent has a restaurant.
plage-notre-dame-porquerolles.note: The most popular and busiest beach on the island: avoid mid to late July and August, and take an early ferry.

plage-de-cannes-la-croisette.access: Croisette has public free beaches among private beach clubs, with 13 public beaches and 12 holding Blue Flag in 2026.
plage-de-cannes-la-croisette.sunbeds: Private clubs charge about 25 EUR off season and 60 to 90 EUR on July-August weekends; seasonal renters on public beaches about 10 to 15 EUR.
plage-de-cannes-la-croisette.note: Fine sand, 7.6 km of beaches. Prices from commercial guides.

almanarre-beach-hyeres.access: Long sandy beach on the Giens peninsula, known for kitesurf and windsurf with dedicated zones.
almanarre-beach-hyeres.parking: Car park at the roundabout end plus spaces near the old salt marshes; theft from cars reported.
almanarre-beach-hyeres.sunbeds: Private beaches along the beach rent loungers.
almanarre-beach-hyeres.food: A few restaurants and private beaches; names not confirmed.
almanarre-beach-hyeres.note: Two zones supervised in summer, with showers and toilets near the roundabout. Gusty wind, intermediate to advanced kite level.

xerokampos-beach-crete.access: Steep, narrow descent; not for large or low-clearance vehicles.
xerokampos-beach-crete.parking: Small free parking area near the beach
xerokampos-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sources disagree: a few sunbeds may be rented at Mazida Ammos; another guide says none.
xerokampos-beach-crete.food: Traditional tavernas in the nearby Ampelos settlement.
xerokampos-beach-crete.note: No shade at Mazida Ammos. The Meltemi can blow in July and August afternoons; mornings are calmer.

spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.access: A few minutes from Villasimius on the Capo Carbonara peninsula; a eucalyptus-shaded path leads from the car park to the sand.
spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.parking: Large car park near the beach; one visitor reported about EUR 10.
spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.sunbeds: Beach services with sunbed and umbrella rental in season.
spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.food: Kiosks, bars and restaurants near the sea.
spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.note: The shallow Notteri lagoon behind the beach is a habitat for pink flamingos.

cala-azzurra-favignana.access: About 5 km from the Favignana ferry terminal, 15 to 20 minutes by bike; ferries from Trapani take about 30 minutes and fill up at weekends.
cala-azzurra-favignana.parking: Small parking area, but most visitors cycle; bike hire is about EUR 5 a day at shops away from the ferry touts.
cala-azzurra-favignana.sunbeds: No sunbed hire confirmed; the beach is mostly rock with a natural seaweed cushion. Lido Burrone nearby has umbrellas.
cala-azzurra-favignana.food: Food trucks and a small bar with cold drinks and snacks nearby; no restaurant.
cala-azzurra-favignana.note: Rocks are sharp in places, so wear sea shoes. The beach fills after 11am.

platja-de-llafranc.access: Summer parking near the beach is not easy; blue-zone paid parking applies.
platja-de-llafranc.parking: Blue-zone paid parking; hard in summer
platja-de-llafranc.food: Several restaurants nearby including El Far, La Sirena and La Llagosta.
platja-de-llafranc.note: Hotel Llafranch is close to the beach and has a restaurant.

sjekirica-beach-brsecine.access: Boat from Dubrovnik, or steep goat paths from the highway, which is rarely done.
sjekirica-beach-brsecine.note: No facilities. The trail near Brsecine has been used as a toilet and dump, so take litter out.

spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.access: About 20 minutes from San Teodoro and 35 from Olbia by car.
spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.parking: Car park fills quickly in summer
spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.sunbeds: Umbrellas, loungers and boats for rent; Lido Kayak in the Punta Est area.
spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.food: Refreshment stands and a sea-view bar at Lido Kayak.
spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.note: Campsite and accessible facilities nearby. Sources do not clearly separate the neighbouring beaches.

agiofarago-beach-crete.access: Parking is about 6 km beyond Kaloi Limenes on a gravel road, then a walk of 30-45 minutes down the gorge. Boat access from Matala and Agia Galini.
agiofarago-beach-crete.parking: Gravel lot about 6 km past Kaloi Limenes
agiofarago-beach-crete.food: A canteen by the car park; nothing at the beach, so bring water and snacks.
agiofarago-beach-crete.note: Wear sturdy shoes. Wild goats climb on cars parked in shade. Naturism is discouraged because of the chapel in the gorge.

aliki-beach-thasos.access: Small bay on a peninsula beside the ancient marble quarry site.
aliki-beach-thasos.parking: Free street parking above the beach and spaces along the main road; arrive early
aliki-beach-thasos.sunbeds: Tavernas rent sunbeds: about EUR 20 for two and an umbrella, or a minimum spend (about EUR 30-70).
aliki-beach-thasos.food: Tavernas such as Leonidas; some offer free sunbeds to diners.
aliki-beach-thasos.note: Calm clear water, good for children. The archaeological site is next to the beach.

kommos-beach-crete.access: The road ends at a car park beside the Minoan site and the beach.
kommos-beach-crete.parking: Free car park at the end of the road
kommos-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sources conflict: municipal loungers about EUR 2 each at the southern end, or none because of turtle conservation.
kommos-beach-crete.food: Two tavernas near the southern cliffs and a food truck reported.
kommos-beach-crete.note: Loggerhead turtle nesting beach with seasonal restrictions. Windy in summer. The Minoan site cannot be entered. The northern part is naturist.

laganas-beach-zakynthos.access: Long sandy beach in the Zakynthos National Marine Park, a loggerhead turtle nesting site.
laganas-beach-zakynthos.parking: No vehicles on the sand; public parking details not confirmed.
laganas-beach-zakynthos.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas are legally capped; surveys found limits exceeded. Do not stick umbrellas in marked nesting zones.
laganas-beach-zakynthos.food: Bars and tavernas on the strip behind the beach.
laganas-beach-zakynthos.note: Beach closed at night in nesting season, reported sunset to sunrise. Nests marked May to October.

tonnara-di-scopello.access: By car to Scopello near Castellammare del Golfo; entry to the beach is through the Tonnara site.
tonnara-di-scopello.parking: Paid lots near the entrance, reported at EUR 7 to 15 a day (more in July).
tonnara-di-scopello.sunbeds: Sunbeds for hire at extra cost.
tonnara-di-scopello.food: Small cafe with snacks and drinks.
tonnara-di-scopello.note: Entry is ticketed (recent visitors reported EUR 15 to 25; buying online helps in high season), so check the official site.

spiaggia-di-capriccioli.access: About 30 km from Olbia via the SS125, SP73 and SP94; there is no regular bus, so use a car or scooter.
spiaggia-di-capriccioli.parking: Small paid lot, reported at EUR 8 to 20 a day; it fills by 9:30am in July and August. Access to the beach is free.
spiaggia-di-capriccioli.food: One visitor mentions a beach bar but this is unverified; bring water.
spiaggia-di-capriccioli.note: Four small coves with turquoise water; arrive early.

baia-verde-gallipoli.access: About 4 km of sand south of Gallipoli with a mix of lidi, free stretches and quiet areas.
baia-verde-gallipoli.parking: Private seasonal lots about 1.50 to 2 EUR per hour; parking is difficult in peak season. Free shuttle from the stadium car park ran 13 June to 31 August in 2026.
baia-verde-gallipoli.sunbeds: Dozens of lidi rent sunbeds and umbrellas; prices not confirmed.
baia-verde-gallipoli.note: Lidi thin out toward Punta della Suina in the south.

cala-liberotto-orosei.access: Easy beach on the Gulf of Orosei.
cala-liberotto-orosei.parking: Free parking reported close to the beach; rentals note free parking is uncommon
cala-liberotto-orosei.sunbeds: Sunbeds and towels rentable on request (one source).
cala-liberotto-orosei.food: Seaside kiosks with ice cream and lunch; two bars reported.
cala-liberotto-orosei.note: Sandy beaches in the gulf are rarely overcrowded. Details come mainly from rental listings.

lokrum-island-dubrovnik.access: Ferry from the Old Port (Luza pier) every 15-30 minutes in high season; about EUR 30 adult return including reserve entry (2026 guide).
lokrum-island-dubrovnik.parking: No cars; ferry from the Old Port
lokrum-island-dubrovnik.sunbeds: None; swim from rocks and piers.
lokrum-island-dubrovnik.food: Cafes and restaurants on the island, pricey; you can bring your own food.
lokrum-island-dubrovnik.note: No sandy beach. Swimming from rocks, the two east piers and a small saltwater lake in the south.

palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.access: Taxi boats from Hvar Town, about 15-30 minutes; roughly EUR 10 each way (reported).
palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.parking: No cars; taxi boat from Hvar Town
palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.sunbeds: Loungers on a narrow shore; about EUR 25 reported.
palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.food: Restaurants and bars in the settlement including Meneghello.
palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.note: Fine gravel and sand beside a pine wood; part is naturist. Busy with boats.

valun-beach-cres.access: Park above Valun, then about 5 minutes downhill on foot.
valun-beach-cres.parking: Parking lot above the village; fee not confirmed
valun-beach-cres.note: Pebble beach, so bring footwear. Also reachable by boat or taxi-boat.

trstevica-beach-prvic.access: Car-free island reached by boat from the mainland.
trstevica-beach-prvic.sunbeds: Pine shade; sunbed rental not consistent across sources.
trstevica-beach-prvic.note: Check ferry times in advance. Konoba opening varies by season.

playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.access: City beach in A Coruna with adapted access.
playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.parking: Parking near Orzan-Riazor (Avenida Buenos Aires) and Parque Adolfo Suarez; fees not confirmed.
playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.food: Kiosks and chiringuitos near the beach; sources differ on details.
playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.note: Lifeguards, showers, changing rooms. Blue Flag. New beach rules with fines up to 3,000 EUR in 2026.

playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.access: No road to the beach: a steep 10 to 15 minute footpath of loose gravel leads down from the clifftop car park on the AL-5106. Wear closed shoes.
playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.parking: Clifftop lot at about EUR 4 to 5 a day in high season and free in low season; it fills early in summer.
playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.sunbeds: None reported: no shade or showers on the sand.
playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.food: No bars on the sand; a drinks stall at the car park, and one guide recommends Chiringuito J. Mariano (location unconfirmed).
playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.note: Bring water, shade and energy for the climb back up.

playa-de-oyambre.access: Walk from the beach access; reached by car via the CA-131.
playa-de-oyambre.parking: Fewer than 50 spaces at the beach access; roadside spots
playa-de-oyambre.food: Food and drink vendors; the Kampaoh campsite has a snack bar.
playa-de-oyambre.note: Toilets, showers, foot rinse and lifeguards. Inside Oyambre Natural Park; protected dunes. Intermediate surf break.

playa-de-arrietara-sopelana.access: Easy on foot or by car.
playa-de-arrietara-sopelana.parking: Supervised car park with more than 100 spaces
playa-de-arrietara-sopelana.food: Bar-chiringuito and a restaurant with a terrace and views.
playa-de-arrietara-sopelana.note: Surf centre of the area, with about six clubs and three schools. Public toilets.

praia-do-monte-clerigo.access: In the village of Monte Clerigo near Aljezur, with the beach just below.
praia-do-monte-clerigo.parking: Street parking near the entrance; it can be crowded in summer.
praia-do-monte-clerigo.food: Restaurants and a beach cafe in the village; toilets reported.
praia-do-monte-clerigo.note: A popular surf beach with a surf school in season. Lifeguard cover varies, so check on arrival.

praia-da-manta-rota.access: Easy, flat beach near the village.
praia-da-manta-rota.parking: Large free car park shaded by trees; paid parking at the Oeste section
praia-da-manta-rota.food: Bars and restaurants on the sand and in the village.
praia-da-manta-rota.note: Lifeguards in the bathing season until about 7 pm; showers and toilets.

praia-do-algodio-ericeira.access: Direct from the village; accessible beach with a prize for access.
praia-do-algodio-ericeira.parking: Park at Sao Sebastiao Urban Park nearby; large capacity
praia-do-algodio-ericeira.food: Cafes and restaurants in the village.
praia-do-algodio-ericeira.note: Showers, toilets and lifeguard. Waves up to 3 m; best at mid to high tide. Bus from Lisbon to the village terminal.

praia-do-tamariz-estoril.access: Small urban beach in front of Estoril Casino, right by Estoril train station.
praia-do-tamariz-estoril.parking: Limited parking along the Marginal; park in a designated area and walk. Mix of free and paid.
praia-do-tamariz-estoril.sunbeds: Sunbed plus umbrella about 40 EUR at a bar-restaurant, no online booking; arrive by 9:30 in peak summer.
praia-do-tamariz-estoril.food: Restaurants, snack bars and an outdoor coffee shop.
praia-do-tamariz-estoril.note: Flagged and lifeguarded in bathing season. Water sports available.

plage-de-morgat-crozon.access: Wide family beach more than 1 km long, from the marina to Rulianec.
plage-de-morgat-crozon.parking: Street parking; a paid motorhome area 15 minutes on foot
plage-de-morgat-crozon.food: Creperies and a hotel restaurant and bar a short walk away.
plage-de-morgat-crozon.note: Summer kids club on the central part. Calm swimming.

plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.access: City beach reached by staircases from the boulevard.
plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.parking: No dedicated surface car park; use city-centre car parks such as Q-Park Diamant, about 3 minutes on foot.
plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.food: Restaurants nearby, the closest about 70 m away.
plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.note: Showers and toilets reported. Dogs not allowed. Buses stop at Saint-Francois or Place de Gaulle.

espiguette-beach-le-grau-du-roi.access: Long open beach reached from two car parks at opposite ends.
espiguette-beach-le-grau-du-roi.parking: Paid car park, about EUR 6 reported, filling quickly on busy days
espiguette-beach-le-grau-du-roi.food: No permanent beach restaurant; occasional vendors.
espiguette-beach-le-grau-du-roi.note: A naturist area lies in the eastern part. Lifeguard coverage not confirmed. Quieter the further you walk from the car park.

plage-de-coz-pors-tregastel.access: Two spacious car parks east of town; avoid parking in town. July and August are busy.
plage-de-coz-pors-tregastel.parking: Two large car parks east of town
plage-de-coz-pors-tregastel.food: A restaurant at the beach (listed by the tourist office).
plage-de-coz-pors-tregastel.note: Supervised in July and August. The GR34 coastal path runs along it, and islets are reachable at low tide.

plage-du-verger-cancale.access: Verger beach can be swum at low tide, big Brittany tides apply.
plage-du-verger-cancale.parking: Large car park at the beach; both free and paid parking listed.
plage-du-verger-cancale.food: Summer snack stand and toilets; restaurants and creperies are at Port de la Houle in town.
plage-du-verger-cancale.note: Supervised in summer. Check tide tables before swimming.

tucepi-beach.access: About 4 km of pebbles backed by pines; a promenade runs above the beach.
tucepi-beach.parking: Reports disagree: about EUR 10 a day, or EUR 20-25 for lots outside town
tucepi-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and parasols for rent; about EUR 30 for two (reported).
tucepi-beach.food: Restaurants and shops on the promenade; a beach bar.
tucepi-beach.note: The longest beach on the Makarska Riviera; pine shade. Busy in summer.

njivice-beach-krk.access: Easy; pebble and concrete stretches along a 1.2 km shaded promenade.
njivice-beach-krk.parking: Limited and busy in summer; private lots near Jadran and Kijac
njivice-beach-krk.sunbeds: Loungers, parasols and watersports rentals reported (general).
njivice-beach-krk.food: Restaurants, cafes and pastry shops around the small port.
njivice-beach-krk.note: Showers and changing rooms at the main stretches. Hidden coves along the path.

donje-celo-beach-kolocep.access: Ferry from Dubrovnik; no cars on the island.
donje-celo-beach-kolocep.food: Two restaurants on the island and a small shop with limited hours.
donje-celo-beach-kolocep.note: Sand beach beside the ferry port. Very busy in high season. Ferry times are hard to find, so check ahead.

argeles-plage.access: Easy; very long flat sandy beach.
argeles-plage.parking: Accessible spaces at several beaches; other parking not confirmed
argeles-plage.sunbeds: Sunbed and parasol rental at private beaches under paillotes.
argeles-plage.food: Beach club and paillotes on the central beach.
argeles-plage.note: Municipal lifeguards; Tamariguer post 14 June to 14 September (2026). Plage Sud is not recommended for reduced mobility.

plage-de-cabasson.access: Paid parking at Parc Capalo in Cabasson, roughly April-November. Brégançon fort beach is reached on foot from here.
plage-de-cabasson.parking: Paid CaPaLo car park, about EUR 11-13
plage-de-cabasson.food: Restaurant, toilets, showers and picnic tables.
plage-de-cabasson.note: Car prices differ between listings; check before you go.

plage-du-dossen.access: Beach car park on Rue de Sieck in Santec; follow the Dossen signs.
plage-du-dossen.parking: Car park on Rue de Sieck, Santec
plage-du-dossen.food: Beach Break creperie, bar and shop facing the sea; surf school at the car park.
plage-du-dossen.note: Dunes and a state forest border the beach. A versatile surf spot.

baie-des-trepasses.access: Dedicated car parks on the access roads; very busy in season.
baie-des-trepasses.parking: Dedicated car parks; very busy in season
baie-des-trepasses.note: Supervised in summer (13:30-19:00 by SNSM, reported); swimming outside supervised hours is prohibited. Strong surf.

nonza-beach.access: On foot from Nonza village: about 15 minutes down a rocky staircase or steep path, and back up.
nonza-beach.parking: Very few paid spaces in the village (pay by card at the machine); one visitor mentions another car park about 2 km further on with an easier walk.
nonza-beach.food: La Sassa restaurant below the tower in the village; busy at lunchtime.
nonza-beach.note: Black pebble beach, so water shoes help. Come early or late to avoid the lunchtime crowd in the village.

ostriconi-beach.access: About 15 km from L Ile-Rousse on the edge of the Agriates desert; reached on foot only, by a path from the former main road.
ostriconi-beach.parking: Not confirmed; a campsite stands about 1 km (11 minutes on foot) from the beach.
ostriconi-beach.food: No restaurant mentioned in the sources, so bring food and water.
ostriconi-beach.note: Supervised in summer. Waves can be dangerous in high winds, and the Agriates coastal path starts at the far end.

plage-du-canadel.access: Easy to reach on foot from the main road.
plage-du-canadel.parking: Signposted car park on the D559 near the chapel; parking is not easy
plage-du-canadel.sunbeds: Paillotes on the left rent mattresses.
plage-du-canadel.food: Paillotes and L Ancre d Or restaurant (open mid-April to mid-September).
plage-du-canadel.note: Free access beach; no dogs 08:00-19:00 from June to September on public stretches.

xi-beach-kefalonia.access: Reached by road; buses run from Lixouri; no boardwalk, so hard for wheelchairs.
xi-beach-kefalonia.parking: Free public parking behind the beach; taverna lots
xi-beach-kefalonia.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent at beach clubs.
xi-beach-kefalonia.food: Tavernas and bars along the beach.
xi-beach-kefalonia.note: Blue Flag. Red sand and clay cliffs; do not take clay away in bulk. Clay can stain light swimwear.

roukounas-beach-anafi.access: Short walk from the bus stop or about 3 km from Chora.
roukounas-beach-anafi.food: Taverna behind the beach, about 50 m from the sea; a second taverna reported.
roukounas-beach-anafi.note: Natural shade from tamarisk trees, hard to get in high season. Toilets and showers reported. Bring an umbrella.

skala-potamia-beach-thasos.parking: Plenty of parking reported; hotels have private lots
skala-potamia-beach-thasos.food: Cafes and 7-8 tavernas in the village.
skala-potamia-beach-thasos.note: Services sit by the small public beach at the south end of a 3 km bay. Reported two Blue Flags.

tolo-beach-peloponnese.parking: Large free parking area along the shore; harder as the town grows
tolo-beach-peloponnese.sunbeds: Deck chairs and umbrellas for rent; about EUR 15 for two (single report).
tolo-beach-peloponnese.food: Many tavernas, especially around Sekeri Street.
tolo-beach-peloponnese.note: One review reports the Blue Flag was lost in 2025; not officially confirmed.

citara-beach-ischia.access: Steps from the road; beach clubs and free sections.
citara-beach-ischia.parking: Several car parks; fees not confirmed
citara-beach-ischia.sunbeds: Paid sunbeds at restaurant-run sections; a couple of free beaches.
citara-beach-ischia.food: Bars and restaurants run beach sections.
citara-beach-ischia.note: Poseidon Gardens thermal park is beside the beach; entry about CHF 44 (third-party listing).

porto-ferro-beach.access: Short walk from the car park; dunes and pines separate the beach from Lake Baratz.
porto-ferro-beach.parking: Free unpaved lot by the beach entrance
porto-ferro-beach.food: A bar and grill at the start of the beach (check season hours); kiosks.
porto-ferro-beach.note: Dogs welcome. The north end near the White Tower is used by naturists. Watch for strong currents on the south side.

baia-del-buondormire-palinuro.access: Boat only: shuttle boats from Palinuro port, or rent a pedal boat or canoe.
baia-del-buondormire-palinuro.parking: Paid parking at Palinuro port, about EUR 1 per hour (reported).
baia-del-buondormire-palinuro.note: Local reports say landing on the shore has been banned since 2020 because of falling rocks. Check locally before going; many visitors swim from the boat.

playa-de-benijo-tenerife.access: Steep footpath and stone steps from the road near Restaurante El Mirador; slippery after rain, not for reduced mobility. One site reports the path is officially closed since a July 2024 landslide order; check before you go.
playa-de-benijo-tenerife.parking: Limited; arrive early or park along the winding roadside
playa-de-benijo-tenerife.sunbeds: None; no rentals, kiosks or showers.
playa-de-benijo-tenerife.food: The mirador restaurant near the access point.
playa-de-benijo-tenerife.note: Strong waves and north-coast swell make swimming unsuitable much of the year; stay waist deep at most.

playazo-de-rodalquilar.access: Dirt road (ALP-826) passable by any car; short walk to the sand from the car park.
playazo-de-rodalquilar.parking: Free car parks at the entrance and near the campsite (50-100 spaces); fills early in high season
playazo-de-rodalquilar.food: No shops or bars; bring everything.
playazo-de-rodalquilar.note: Litter bins and cleaning service. Inside the Cabo de Gata natural park; sources disagree on the walk length.

playa-de-xago.access: Reached by short paths from nearby parking areas; one source gives a long walk.
playa-de-xago.parking: Parking areas nearby; details not confirmed
playa-de-xago.note: Lifeguard service and a picnic area. A long exposed beach with surf, about 20 minutes west of Gijon.

praia-do-rostro-fisterra.access: Small car park directly on the beach, about 5-6 km from Fisterra.
praia-do-rostro-fisterra.parking: Small lot for about 10 vehicles; busier in the evening
praia-do-rostro-fisterra.food: No bar confirmed at the beach.
praia-do-rostro-fisterra.note: No lifeguard or surf information found.

praia-da-amoreira-aljezur.access: Beach at the mouth of the Aljezur river in the Vicentine Coast Natural Park. At low tide you can wade across to the far side; not at high tide.
praia-da-amoreira-aljezur.parking: Car park and street parking; full by about 11:30 on summer days
praia-da-amoreira-aljezur.food: Restaurante Paraiso do Mar above the beach, with toilets (older guide); a small beach bar on the north side.
praia-da-amoreira-aljezur.note: Lifeguards in season (older guide). Currents near the river mouth can be strong at high tide.

praia-de-moledo.parking: Car park right in front of the beach, reported free
praia-de-moledo.food: Restaurant and nearby bars such as Hamilton and Paredao 476.
praia-de-moledo.note: Lifeguarded with toilets. Blue Flag reported in one listing.

praia-da-gale-albufeira.parking: Free parking at the east entrance; limited in summer
praia-da-gale-albufeira.sunbeds: Umbrellas and loungers for rent in the busy east section.
praia-da-gale-albufeira.food: Bars and three restaurants along the beach.
praia-da-gale-albufeira.note: Currents can be strong. Bus from Albufeira to Gale village.

kolovare-beach-zadar.access: Easy; city beach near the old town.
kolovare-beach-zadar.parking: Hotel parking reported; public parking not confirmed
kolovare-beach-zadar.sunbeds: Loungers and umbrellas for a fee.
kolovare-beach-zadar.food: Two beach bars at the hotel; other bars nearby.
kolovare-beach-zadar.note: Details are from hotel listings. Check city sources.

raduca-beach-primosten.access: Walk from Primosten; two pebble stretches.
raduca-beach-primosten.parking: About EUR 10 per day, 10 minutes on foot (reported)
raduca-beach-primosten.sunbeds: About EUR 18 for two chairs and parasol (reported).
raduca-beach-primosten.food: Bars and restaurants behind the beach; seafood and Italian dishes.
raduca-beach-primosten.note: Changing rooms, toilets and showers. Busy in summer; arrive early.

bijeca-beach-medulin.access: Roughly 1 km beach on the Medulin coast with trees above for shade.
bijeca-beach-medulin.parking: Summer parking crowded; rules and tariffs not confirmed.
bijeca-beach-medulin.sunbeds: Loungers and parasols for rent; reviewers mention paid sunbeds.
bijeca-beach-medulin.food: Cafes, bars and restaurants in Medulin.
bijeca-beach-medulin.note: Reviews mixed on cleanliness and crowding.

escalet-beach-ramatuelle.access: Short walk from the car park; the coastal path from Cap Camarat also leads here.
escalet-beach-ramatuelle.parking: Car park near the beach (about 10 spaces on the day lot); price not confirmed
escalet-beach-ramatuelle.food: Restaurant AMICI at Hotel L Escalet serves breakfast and lunch; catering nearby.
escalet-beach-ramatuelle.note: Toilets, showers and supervised bathing in season. Not wheelchair accessible.

arone-beach-piana.access: About 15-20 minutes by a narrow mountain road from Piana, then a stairway to the sea.
arone-beach-piana.parking: Partly shaded car park above the beach; spaces are hard to find in summer.
arone-beach-piana.food: Several restaurants and beach bars on the beach.
arone-beach-piana.note: Supervised in season, with a disabled access mat and an amphibious wheelchair (reported).

capo-di-feno-beach.access: Path from the car park; narrow winding road D111B, about 20 minutes from Ajaccio.
capo-di-feno-beach.parking: Free car and bike parking nearby
capo-di-feno-beach.food: A paillote with snacks and drinks.
capo-di-feno-beach.note: No showers or toilets. Lifeguard in July and August only (one source). Grand Capo and Petit Capo are two parts.

playa-de-ondarreta.access: Flat city beach, walk or bus from the centre.
playa-de-ondarreta.parking: No beach car park; a private garage about 12 minutes walk away
playa-de-ondarreta.food: Cafes and restaurants along the promenade.
playa-de-ondarreta.note: Toilets, changing rooms, showers (about EUR 1.60) and lifeguards. Facilities open 9:00-20:30 in July and August.

playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.access: Long beach in the resort of Playa d en Bossa with beach clubs, backed by the strip.
playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.parking: Public beach parking not confirmed; hotels charge for their own.
playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.sunbeds: Sun loungers priced at the upper end of Ibiza; an older source reported about 4 to 8 EUR islandwide.
playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.food: Beach clubs and bars along the sand.
playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.note: Showers and lifeguards reported by one weak source; check locally.

baia-di-sistiana.access: Steps down to a small pebble bay.
baia-di-sistiana.sunbeds: Deck chair and umbrella rental; Cohiba beach club takes online bookings.
baia-di-sistiana.food: Beach bars, including evening service, and hot lunch dishes.
baia-di-sistiana.note: Free public beach plus a paid club; entry fee reported at some sections. Crowded on weekends.

cala-bianca-marina-di-camerota.access: Boat from Marina di Camerota in summer; private boats cannot moor. On foot about 40 minutes from Camping Romano or 1.5 hours from Lentiscelle.
cala-bianca-marina-di-camerota.parking: Parking about 20 minutes walk from the beach on an unpaved road; paid harbour parking about EUR 1 per hour
cala-bianca-marina-di-camerota.food: Lido Nettuno nearby for casual dining; nothing on the beach.
cala-bianca-marina-di-camerota.note: Roads are rocky and potholed. Anchoring is prohibited and the coast guard patrols.

kalogria-beach.access: Easy; long sandy beach next to Strofylia forest.
kalogria-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas at some points; a free area for your own.
kalogria-beach.food: Beach bar and a few hotel restaurants nearby.
kalogria-beach.note: Blue Flag, about 9 km long, next to the Strofylia pine forest and dunes.

praia-de-mira.access: Easy; flat sandy beach beside the town.
praia-de-mira.parking: Car park at the south beach; details not confirmed
praia-de-mira.food: Cafes and restaurants nearby serving seafood.
praia-de-mira.note: Long-time Blue Flag beach. Lifeguards in season; reports differ on showers.

praia-do-furadouro.access: Atlantic beach with surf conditions in Ovar municipality.
praia-do-furadouro.parking: Car park with free parking plus roadside parking; busy at peak times.
praia-do-furadouro.sunbeds: Sunshade and deckchair rental listed by one source.
praia-do-furadouro.food: Nearby restaurants: Amadeu, Restaurante Dunas, Casa Rocha.
praia-do-furadouro.note: Supervised beach reported. Sources disagree on showers and toilets; the last toilet may be at the car park.

pupnatska-luka-beach-korcula.access: Road from Pupnat down to the bay.
pupnatska-luka-beach-korcula.parking: Parking within about 100 m; EUR 7-10 a day reported.
pupnatska-luka-beach-korcula.food: Two bars: Konoba Kod Mate and the Dalmos beach restaurant.
pupnatska-luka-beach-korcula.note: Showers available. Crowded in July and August; some places take cash only.

suha-punta-beach-rab.parking: Car park close to the beach, about 100 m
suha-punta-beach-rab.sunbeds: Loungers and umbrellas for a fee.
suha-punta-beach-rab.food: Oliva Grill about 30 m away; other bars nearby.
suha-punta-beach-rab.note: Showers and a lifeguard are listed.

platja-de-sa-riera-begur.access: Cove about 7 minutes from Begur, reached on foot or by car.
platja-de-sa-riera-begur.parking: Free parking reported; arrive early in peak summer
platja-de-sa-riera-begur.food: Bar and nearby restaurants such as El Raco de Sa Riera.
platja-de-sa-riera-begur.note: Showers, WC and Red Cross assisted bathing. A parking space for reduced mobility.

agia-marina-beach-aegina.access: Sandy beach about 500 m long in the Agia Marina resort, shallow water suited to small children.
agia-marina-beach-aegina.parking: Public beach parking not confirmed; many hotels offer their own.
agia-marina-beach-aegina.food: Seafront tavernas, cafes and bars along the promenade.
agia-marina-beach-aegina.note: Water sports and beach bars. Arrive early in high season for a good spot.

livadi-beach-astypalaia.access: Easy by car or bus; about 20 minutes downhill on foot from Chora.
livadi-beach-astypalaia.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas at the organised parts.
livadi-beach-astypalaia.food: Cafes and tavernas along the beach; some seasonal.
livadi-beach-astypalaia.note: The busiest organised beach on the island, with tree shade. About 2 to 3 km from Chora.

copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.access: Pebble and concrete beach in Lapad, popular for sundowners.
copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.parking: Limited space near the beach; designated areas advised, free parking reported about 200 m away.
copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent; reviewers report high prices.
copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.food: Restaurant and bar on the beach; nearby Restaurant Panorama, Bacchus Bistro and Pantarul.
copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.note: Showers available. Many visitors use their own towels.

playa-del-postiguet-alicante.access: Easy; flat city beach below Santa Barbara castle.
playa-del-postiguet-alicante.parking: Underground car park under the promenade about EUR 1.50-2 per hour (2026 guide); street parking hard
playa-del-postiguet-alicante.sunbeds: Sunbed and parasol about EUR 10-15 per day (guide); may be limited early in the season.
playa-del-postiguet-alicante.food: Chiringuitos and restaurants along the beach; about five at the nightlife end.
playa-del-postiguet-alicante.note: Lifeguard 10:00-20:00 from 1 June to 15 September (official page). Central and busy.

playa-de-el-sardinero-santander.access: Flat urban beaches beside Mesones Park.
playa-de-el-sardinero-santander.parking: Large parking area by the Segunda beach; nearby streets harder
playa-de-el-sardinero-santander.food: Restaurants such as Abra, La Cania and Maremondo near the beach.
playa-de-el-sardinero-santander.note: Toilets, showers, lifeguards in high season, play area and paddle courts.

biodola-beach-elba.access: Easy; the road is widened in places for parking.
biodola-beach-elba.parking: Roadside parking allowed if traffic is not blocked; arrive early
biodola-beach-elba.food: Several bars, restaurants and ice cream shops on the bay.
biodola-beach-elba.note: Facilities are among the best on Elba. Lifeguard service not confirmed.

pramousquier-beach.access: Steps from the back alley down to the beach; harder to find than neighbouring beaches.
pramousquier-beach.parking: Park in the back alley off the D559 after Hotel Beau Site
pramousquier-beach.note: Canoe and SUP rental. About 2 km from Canadel by the old railway greenway.

praia-da-vieira-marinha-grande.access: Easy; flat beach beside the village.
praia-da-vieira-marinha-grande.food: Bar and restaurant at the beach; NauFragil nearby for seafood.
praia-da-vieira-marinha-grande.note: Lifeguards, showers and toilets. The sea is strong. Bathing season from about 15 June to 15 September.

psili-ammos-beach-serifos.access: Reachable by bus or a 30 minute walk from Chora; concrete steps to the sand.
psili-ammos-beach-serifos.parking: Parking inside the tavernas or along the street, then a short walk
psili-ammos-beach-serifos.sunbeds: Sources disagree: a beach bar with sunbeds in the middle, or none organised.
psili-ammos-beach-serifos.note: Tamarisk trees give shade; some wooden umbrellas installed by the community.

livadakia-beach-serifos.access: Easy from the road; short walk from Livadi.
livadakia-beach-serifos.sunbeds: Sunbeds from the Alexandros restaurant and Vasileia cafe-bar; small organised area.
livadakia-beach-serifos.food: Alexandros restaurant and Vasileia cafe-bar; more tavernas close by.
livadakia-beach-serifos.note: Fine sand and tamarisk shade in the unorganised part. Island campsite and pool nearby.

pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.access: Beach reached on foot from the car park.
pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.parking: Free roadside parking about 50 m away; a small lot near the restaurant fills early
pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas about EUR 10 reported, limited numbers.
pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.food: A bar and restaurant on the beach.
pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.note: Water is steep near the shore and rough when windy. Bring your own umbrella for afternoon shade.

pollonia-beach-milos.access: Fine golden sand beach in a fishing village on the northeast coast of Milos, shaded by tamarisk trees.
pollonia-beach-milos.parking: Public beach parking not confirmed; private parking at hotels.
pollonia-beach-milos.sunbeds: Hotel sunbeds and umbrellas; public rental not confirmed.
pollonia-beach-milos.food: Waterfront tavernas; book in the morning for a beach table.
pollonia-beach-milos.note: Working harbour beside the beach. Family-friendly. Wind conditions not confirmed.

fasolou-beach-sifnos.access: Needs some walking from the road; secluded.
fasolou-beach-sifnos.food: None on the beach; bring supplies.
fasolou-beach-sifnos.note: Secluded beach on Sifnos; details are thin, so check recent reports.

frangokastello-beach-crete.parking: Gravel lot next to the castle; reports of about EUR 2 or free
frangokastello-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrella about EUR 6-7 per set.
frangokastello-beach-crete.food: Four or five tavernas near the castle.
frangokastello-beach-crete.note: Shallow water; north winds can make it rough. Orthi Ammos lies 300 m east over dunes.

agia-roumeli-beach-crete.access: By boat or on foot only; no road. Boats run daily April to late October from Chora Sfakion.
agia-roumeli-beach-crete.sunbeds: Some umbrellas and sunbeds in front of the village tavernas; water bikes.
agia-roumeli-beach-crete.food: Several tavernas, busy with Samaria Gorge hikers.
agia-roumeli-beach-crete.note: Coarse grey sand and black pebbles. Crowded 13:00-17:00 when hikers arrive; quiet after the last ferry. Mashali at the west end has taverna sunbeds.

los-canos-de-meca-beach.access: Signposted access points; reached on foot or by car from the A-2233.
los-canos-de-meca-beach.parking: Unpatrolled car parks with fewer than 50 spaces
los-canos-de-meca-beach.food: Chiringuitos nearby such as El Chiringuito de Juan and La Palapa (location relative to the beach not confirmed).
los-canos-de-meca-beach.note: Toilets, showers and sports hire listed. A bus runs from Barbate.

playa-de-zahora-barbate.access: Hard by car; leave the car on the road through Zahora or at Sajorami.
playa-de-zahora-barbate.food: Chiringuitos in the busiest north-east zone, such as Chiringuito de Juan.
playa-de-zahora-barbate.note: Summer toilets, showers, changing rooms and lifeguards in the northeast zone (one guide); other sources list few facilities.

playa-de-carnota.access: Long open beach with mountain views.
playa-de-carnota.parking: Parking at the beach (details not confirmed)
playa-de-carnota.food: Bar O Cuberto bar and grill near the beach.
playa-de-carnota.note: More than 7 km long, the longest in Galicia. Little shade; showers. Parts are naturist.

cala-en-porter-menorca.access: About 180-200 steps down from the village; a seasonal mini-train covers the descent.
cala-en-porter-menorca.parking: Dedicated car park behind the beach (about a 3 minute walk down); tight in summer
cala-en-porter-menorca.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols and pedal boats for hire.
cala-en-porter-menorca.food: Bar, restaurant and a shop at the beach; more eateries in the village.
cala-en-porter-menorca.note: Sheltered by cliffs, sandy and shallow so good for families. Lifeguard in summer.

porto-pollo-beach-palau.access: Easy; separate zones for kiting, windsurfing and swimming.
porto-pollo-beach-palau.parking: Large day car park, paid by day and free overnight
porto-pollo-beach-palau.food: Bars and restaurants such as Rupi s Beach Bar and Bar Tiki.
porto-pollo-beach-palau.note: RRD Kitesurf Centre runs lessons and rental. Reviewers say lessons and rentals are pricey.

pescoluse-beach-salento.access: Easy and flat; known as the Maldives of Salento.
pescoluse-beach-salento.sunbeds: Paid lido sections with umbrellas; free areas where you can rent sunbeds or bring your own umbrella.
pescoluse-beach-salento.food: Many beach bars and restaurants close by.
pescoluse-beach-salento.note: Cleanliness reviews are mixed, better in high season. Shade in public areas is limited.

cupabia-beach-corsica.access: Easy from the car park. A steep dirt path of about 25 minutes leads to a small cove reachable only on foot or by boat.
cupabia-beach-corsica.food: Paillote beach restaurant with menus from about EUR 20; bar and campsite in summer.
cupabia-beach-corsica.note: Wild beach about 8 km north of Porto-Pollo.

soline-beach-brela.access: Easy; next to the Bluesun Hotel Soline.
soline-beach-brela.parking: Not confirmed. One hotel guest paid EUR 9 per day off-site.
soline-beach-brela.sunbeds: Paid beach club at the hotel.
soline-beach-brela.note: Details are thin for the public beach; check on arrival.

gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.access: Several beaches along 16 km; Gornja Vala is the longest.
gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.parking: Parking free at some hotels; a reviewer got a ticket at Duba bay
gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.sunbeds: Free for guests at some hotels; water sports for a fee.
gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.food: Restaurants on the promenade and in hotels.
gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.note: Details for the main town beach are thin; check the Gradac tourist board.

omis-beach.access: Velika plaza near the Cetina mouth is a long public beach; Galeb beach is by the river mouth.
omis-beach.parking: Public parking near the beach; one reviewer reported 1.5 EUR per hour (June 2025). Parking is paid by the hour at Galeb.
omis-beach.sunbeds: Parasols and loungers for rent; a reviewer quoted 10 EUR per umbrella, price per sunbed unverified.
omis-beach.food: Bars and restaurants serve local dishes; Duce has many cafes and snack bars.
omis-beach.note: Small dog beach near the river mouth. Afternoon parking is hard in Duce.

praia-da-mareta-sagres.access: Easy; short walk from the car park to the sand below Sagres fortress.
praia-da-mareta-sagres.parking: Car park by the beach; reviews say spaces run short at peak hours
praia-da-mareta-sagres.food: Bars and restaurants nearby, such as Tonel Beach Bar and Mar a Vista.
praia-da-mareta-sagres.note: Reviewers miss public showers and changing rooms. Winter surf is possible; summer swimming is cooler than the south coast.

praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.access: Easy; flat sandy beach beside the north pier.
praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.parking: Car park by the beach; free lots along the coast road
praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.food: Beach bars and cafes; Trinca Espinhas about 10 m away.
praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.note: Lifeguard post next to the north pier in summer. Motorhome area dated.

praia-do-magoito-sintra.access: Steep path down; a ramp is reported for reduced mobility.
praia-do-magoito-sintra.parking: Car park near the beach; details not confirmed
praia-do-magoito-sintra.food: Beach bar and restaurant on site; Esplanada Duna Mar nearby.
praia-do-magoito-sintra.note: Blue Flag in the 2020s listings (season about 30 May to 13 September). Lifeguards, showers and toilets reported in season.

plage-des-blancs-sablons-le-conquet.access: Short path of about 5 minutes from the car park; Le Conquet is 15 minutes on foot.
plage-des-blancs-sablons-le-conquet.parking: Free unpaved lot (about 10 spaces) and a larger gravel lot; mostly used by surfers
plage-des-blancs-sablons-le-conquet.food: No beach facilities; the campsite nearby has toilets and showers.
plage-des-blancs-sablons-le-conquet.note: Sloped parking, no services at the car park.

kerfissien-beach-cleder.access: Not confirmed; the beach is a short walk from the Kerfissien houses.
kerfissien-beach-cleder.note: No public facilities information found. The sandy Les Amiets beach is about 800 m away.

la-capte-beach-hyeres.access: Beach at the end of a village street in La Capte, with direct beach access.
la-capte-beach-hyeres.parking: Free and paid parking listed; parking is at the end of a street in the village.
la-capte-beach-hyeres.sunbeds: Not confirmed at La Capte; free sunbed loan reported at nearby Bergerie.
la-capte-beach-hyeres.food: A few restaurants in La Capte village.
la-capte-beach-hyeres.note: Supervised in summer. Public toilets and showers reported.

valtos-beach-parga.access: Easy from the road car park; or 15-20 minutes on foot over Castle Hill from Parga.
valtos-beach-parga.parking: Large free car park alongside half the beach
valtos-beach-parga.sunbeds: Beach clubs in the middle rent sunbeds; about EUR 15-25 per set (reported); free zones at the edges.
valtos-beach-parga.food: Bars and restaurants serve each beach sector; some clubs ask a minimum spend.
valtos-beach-parga.note: Water taxi from Parga runs every 30 minutes in season (EUR 3-6 reported). No bus to Parga.

agios-pavlos-beach-rethymno.access: Paved road from Sachtouria; dunes beside the village. Do not confuse it with the Sfakia Agios Pavlos (no road).
agios-pavlos-beach-rethymno.sunbeds: Partly organised with umbrellas and sunbeds; some tavernas rent loungers.
agios-pavlos-beach-rethymno.note: Large sand dunes. The neighbouring Akoumiani beach is reached by a path and is often wavy.

marathias-beach-zakynthos.access: Short dirt road; beach is small and pebbly.
marathias-beach-zakynthos.food: Two tavernas sit above the bay; no beach bar confirmed.
marathias-beach-zakynthos.note: Part of the Zakynthos National Marine Park. Loggerhead turtles may be seen in the bay.

kefalos-beach-kos.access: Easy by road; long open bay.
kefalos-beach-kos.parking: Large area in front of the beach and along the access road; busy in peak season
kefalos-beach-kos.sunbeds: Sunbeds for rent, about EUR 12-15 for two with an umbrella (reported, nearby beaches).
kefalos-beach-kos.food: Tavernas and cafes in the village about 1.4 km away.
kefalos-beach-kos.note: Flat-water bay with strong afternoon wind, popular for windsurfing; light winds in the morning suit beginners.

fakistra-beach-pelion.access: Leave the car on the road plateau, then walk a footpath of about 200 m to 20 minutes depending on source.
fakistra-beach-pelion.parking: Roadside parking on the plateau above the beach
fakistra-beach-pelion.food: None on the beach; food options in nearby villages.
fakistra-beach-pelion.note: Steps and tavernas belong to nearby Mylopotamos, not Fakistra. Bring water and shade.

voulisma-beach-istro.access: Paths lead down from the main road above.
voulisma-beach-istro.parking: Along the main road above the beach.
voulisma-beach-istro.sunbeds: Umbrellas and sunbeds; about EUR 15 for two sunbeds and an umbrella reported.
voulisma-beach-istro.food: Canteen at the end of the beach; Taverna Panorama nearby in Istron.
voulisma-beach-istro.note: The main strip is narrow and mostly covered by sunbeds. Showers and water sports. Also called Golden Beach.
voulisma-beach-istro.lifeguard: Lifeguard station on the main strip.

playa-de-somo-cantabria.parking: Paid car park on C. las Quebrantas, plus street parking reported
playa-de-somo-cantabria.food: Beach bars along the beach and cafes in town.
playa-de-somo-cantabria.note: Lifeguards, showers and parking listed by Spain.info. Escuela Cantabra de Surf and other schools run lessons (from about EUR 35).

playa-de-la-mata-torrevieja.access: Sandy beach in La Mata, Torrevieja, with Blue Flag and a pine and dune setting.
playa-de-la-mata-torrevieja.sunbeds: Hammocks, loungers and parasols for hire, plus water sports rental.
playa-de-la-mata-torrevieja.note: Lifeguard post in high and medium season, showers and toilets.

torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.access: Long seafront beach closest to Velez-Malaga, with regular buses to town.
torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.sunbeds: Daybeds at beach clubs such as Cafe del Mar and Berebere.
torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.food: Chiringuitos grilling espetos of sardines over coals.
torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.note: Lifeguards along the seafront. Blue Flag and tourist quality labels reported.

algajola-beach-corsica.sunbeds: Private beach clubs rent sunbeds; bring your own on the public stretch.
algajola-beach-corsica.food: Three or four restaurants on or near the beach.
algajola-beach-corsica.note: Steep entry to the sea. One reviewer warns against leaving belongings unattended.

cargese-beach-peru-corsica.access: Easy; walk from the car park behind the dunes.
cargese-beach-peru-corsica.parking: Large free car park at the edge of the beach
cargese-beach-peru-corsica.sunbeds: Paillotes such as Laetitia and Letizia rent sunbeds and umbrellas.
cargese-beach-peru-corsica.food: Paillotes serve light meals and salads; beach restaurants and bars.
cargese-beach-peru-corsica.note: First aid station. No public toilets or bins reported. Shallow water; jellyfish and litter after storms reported.

sagone-beach-corsica.access: Easy; long sandy beach with gentle slope.
sagone-beach-corsica.food: Shops and restaurants around the beach.
sagone-beach-corsica.note: Supervised in season, with disabled access equipment at the first aid station. Water sports in summer.

ile-rousse-beach-corsica.parking: No parking at the town beach; paid lots near the station and Place Paoli; Caruchettu has a free field
ile-rousse-beach-corsica.sunbeds: A Siesta rents sunbeds under yellow umbrellas.
ile-rousse-beach-corsica.food: About 17 restaurants within walking distance; some on the beach.
ile-rousse-beach-corsica.note: Napoleon and Caruchettu beaches supervised June to September; the station beach is not.

scivu-beach-sardinia.access: From the SS126 near Arbus follow the signs onto a narrow, partly unpaved track for about 13 km to the car park, then walk a few hundred metres along a wooden walkway through the dunes.
scivu-beach-sardinia.parking: Gravel lot of about 70 spaces; one visitor paid EUR 15 for the day (8am to 8pm), free at night. No toilets reported at the lot.
scivu-beach-sardinia.sunbeds: Umbrellas can be rented at the kiosk near the beach.
scivu-beach-sardinia.food: Kiosk and a restaurant by the beach, plus a snack bar up some steps; freshwater showers in summer.
scivu-beach-sardinia.note: The beach is fully exposed to the mistral, so check the wind before swimming and stay on the dune walkway.

mazzaro-beach-taormina.access: Steps or the Taormina cable car then a short walk.
mazzaro-beach-taormina.parking: Few spaces; hotel parking about EUR 25 per day (one hotel); nearest public lot at the cable car square
mazzaro-beach-taormina.sunbeds: Lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; Spisone is cheaper.
mazzaro-beach-taormina.note: Pebble beach in a sheltered bay. Isola Bella is reachable on foot.

noli-beach-liguria.access: Easy; free Fishermen Beach beside the old town.
noli-beach-liguria.parking: Paid and free parking in town; limited in peak season
noli-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Paid lidos such as Bagni Ondina rent loungers and umbrellas; free beach too.
noli-beach-liguria.food: Bars and restaurants in the old town.
noli-beach-liguria.note: Stones and gravel, more sandy towards the back. Lidos have showers and changing rooms.

numana-beach-marche.access: Park in Numana and walk down; Spiaggiola is reached by path or shuttle.
numana-beach-marche.parking: Park in Numana town and walk or take the shuttle
numana-beach-marche.sunbeds: Lidos rent umbrellas and sunbeds; front rows cost more and are often reserved.
numana-beach-marche.food: Restaurant at Spiaggiola; bars at the lidos.
numana-beach-marche.note: Showers and changing rooms at the lidos. Spiaggiola gets crowded in peak season.

lerici-beach-liguria.access: Easy; flat promenade from town to San Terenzo.
lerici-beach-liguria.parking: Paid car parks such as La Vallata; Limited Traffic Zone applies in the town
lerici-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Umbrellas, sunbeds and pedal boats for rent at Venere Azzurra; private lidos too.
lerici-beach-liguria.food: Bars and restaurants on the promenade.
lerici-beach-liguria.note: Venere Azzurra is free to enter. Restrooms; no lifeguards reported there.

praia-dos-salgados-albufeira.access: Easy; flat access from the car park.
praia-dos-salgados-albufeira.parking: Large car park on the west side beside the lagoon
praia-dos-salgados-albufeira.food: Os Salgados restaurant right on the sand.
praia-dos-salgados-albufeira.note: Blue Flag, lifeguards in bathing season, showers and toilets. Salgados Lagoon behind the dunes is a bird site.

praia-de-melides-alentejo.access: Sand strip between the sea and the Melides lagoon; the lagoon is used for paddleboarding and kayaking.
praia-de-melides-alentejo.parking: Free parking; fills on summer weekends. Melides village is about 4 km away.
praia-de-melides-alentejo.food: A beachside restaurant usually operates in summer.
praia-de-melides-alentejo.note: Blue Flag and lifeguard listings exist but are ambiguous; verify locally. Good for birdwatching.

praia-de-galapos-arrabida.access: Steps lead down to a small cove.
praia-de-galapos-arrabida.parking: Tight and hard on summer weekends. Cars are restricted until 15 September under the Arrabida sem Carros program.
praia-de-galapos-arrabida.note: Some sources mix up Galapos with neighbouring Galapinhos.

prasonisi-beach-rhodes.access: Reached by car at the end of the road; buses run in summer (check timetables).
prasonisi-beach-rhodes.parking: Informal free parking at the end of the road; rough access road
prasonisi-beach-rhodes.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent (one source).
prasonisi-beach-rhodes.food: Tavernas and restaurants at the entrance; bring a picnic.
prasonisi-beach-rhodes.note: Wind and kite surfing centres rent boards, sails and wetsuits and give lessons. One side is windy and choppy, the other calmer. Toilets and showers are limited.

myrtiotissa-beach-corfu.access: Steep rock steps from the road, about 250-500 m. Do not drive down without a 4x4.
myrtiotissa-beach-corfu.parking: Small lots near Elia Taverna; no dedicated car park.
myrtiotissa-beach-corfu.food: Small kiosk or canteen reported; sources differ.
myrtiotissa-beach-corfu.note: Naturist beach with no natural shade. Crowded in summer and not suited to families.

liapades-beach-corfu.access: Mostly by car or boat; steep paths nearby.
liapades-beach-corfu.parking: Almost no spaces; Rovinia car park is a separate beach
liapades-beach-corfu.sunbeds: Organised with sunbeds, canoes and motorboats for hire.
liapades-beach-corfu.food: A few tavernas and cafes on the beach and between the village and beach.
liapades-beach-corfu.note: Prices are reasonable but higher right by the beach.

myrtos-beach-ierapetra.access: Extensive beach of dark sand and small pebbles beside Myrtos village, about 15 km west of Ierapetra.
myrtos-beach-ierapetra.sunbeds: Umbrellas and sunbeds for rent under tamarisk shade.
myrtos-beach-ierapetra.food: Taverns and cafes line the main beach.
myrtos-beach-ierapetra.note: Showers, changing rooms and lifeguards reported. Reportedly not affected by the meltemi.

psarou-beach-mykonos.access: Easy by road; busy beach club strip.
psarou-beach-mykonos.parking: Parking about EUR 15-20, fills fast in July and August
psarou-beach-mykonos.sunbeds: Beach clubs charge about EUR 220-800 for a pair in peak season plus minimum spend (guides); hotel sections free for guests.
psarou-beach-mykonos.food: Beach clubs such as Nammos with restaurants.
psarou-beach-mykonos.note: Mykonos most exclusive beach. Book ahead in peak season. Prices vary widely by day.

sant-andrea-beach-elba.access: Easy to reach by road; beach is a mix of sand and rocks.
sant-andrea-beach-elba.parking: Small free car park about 200 m away; a private paid lot is closer (about EUR 14 per day, reported)
sant-andrea-beach-elba.sunbeds: Paid sunbeds and umbrellas at the lidos; free stretches remain.
sant-andrea-beach-elba.food: A beach bar and eateries at the lidos.
sant-andrea-beach-elba.note: Lifeguard in season. Arrive early; the car parks fill fast.

capo-vaticano-beach-calabria.access: Steps lead down from the road.
capo-vaticano-beach-calabria.parking: Public and private parking nearby (reported for the area).
capo-vaticano-beach-calabria.note: Details for this exact beach are not confirmed; most sources cover neighbouring beaches.

varigotti-beach-liguria.access: Easy; walk along the village seafront.
varigotti-beach-liguria.parking: Few real car parks; arrive early or walk from Finalborgo or Noli
varigotti-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Lidos charge about EUR 20-65 for an umbrella and two sunbeds (reported); Baia dei Saraceni has free open space.
varigotti-beach-liguria.food: Bagni Al Saraceno has a bar and restaurant; village cafes.
varigotti-beach-liguria.note: Baia dei Saraceni lies inside the Bergeggi regional park area. Public transport reaches the village.

bergeggi-beach-liguria.access: By road along the Aurelia; buses from Savona and Spotorno.
bergeggi-beach-liguria.parking: Free and paid parking near the beach; fills quickly in high season
bergeggi-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Paid beach clubs rent sunbeds and umbrellas; a free section too.
bergeggi-beach-liguria.note: Free sections have outdoor showers and toilets. Marine reserve nearby.

chiaia-di-luna-beach-ponza.access: Land access is closed: the tunnel has been shut after rockfalls. The beach is seen from boats or from the cliffs.
chiaia-di-luna-beach-ponza.note: Italian news reports say the tunnel is closed and no reopening date was found. Check with the Ponza municipality before planning a visit.

praia-da-senhora-da-rocha-porches.access: Drive to the car park on the cliff top beside the chapel; the beach lies below, between the headland and Praia Nova.
praia-da-senhora-da-rocha-porches.parking: Car park on top of the cliffs; one blogger found it free, but check locally.
praia-da-senhora-da-rocha-porches.food: Restaurante Vilarinho is on the beach and serves fresh fish; there is also a beach bar.
praia-da-senhora-da-rocha-porches.note: Lifeguard, toilets and showers in season. The 14th century chapel stands on the headland, and boats leave from the beach for trips to nearby grottoes.

praia-de-afife-viana-do-castelo.access: Easy; access roads from the N13.
praia-de-afife-viana-do-castelo.parking: Car park by the beach, often unpaved; fills on summer weekends
praia-de-afife-viana-do-castelo.food: Beachfront restaurant serving seafood rice, open late in season.
praia-de-afife-viana-do-castelo.note: Lifeguard and Blue Flag listed. Restrooms and showers. Surf spot.

praia-da-cordoama-vila-do-bispo.access: Tarred access road ends at the beach.
praia-da-cordoama-vila-do-bispo.parking: Fairly large car park; tight on summer weekends
praia-da-cordoama-vila-do-bispo.food: Small beach bar and restaurant by the car park; hours shift out of season.
praia-da-cordoama-vila-do-bispo.note: Blue Flag and seasonal lifeguards. Strong waves suit surfing, not swimming; rocks on shore and in the water. Surf schools operate.

medena-beach-seget-vranjica.access: Pebble beach with pine shade, partly occupied by the Medena resort area.
medena-beach-seget-vranjica.parking: Parking mainly tied to the hotels; public parking not confirmed.
medena-beach-seget-vranjica.sunbeds: Umbrellas and sun loungers at the resort beach; public rental price not found.
medena-beach-seget-vranjica.food: Resort restaurants and a beach bar.
medena-beach-seget-vranjica.note: Crowds described as packed in high season.

trpanj-beach-peljesac.access: Small Peljesac town; nearby Divna beach has parking and a bar-restaurant on the sand.
trpanj-beach-peljesac.parking: Parking available at Divna; marked spaces including accessible ones at Pozora.
trpanj-beach-peljesac.sunbeds: Sunbed and parasol rental reported at Pozora.
trpanj-beach-peljesac.food: Tuna Bar Trpanj and Konoba Ribar in town; bar-restaurant at Divna.
trpanj-beach-peljesac.note: Showers and toilets at Pozora. Hours and prices not confirmed.

cala-gracio-ibiza.access: On foot or by bus (lines 105 and 106 from San Antonio); small boats from the harbour.
cala-gracio-ibiza.parking: Limited car park; the beach bar lot has an attendant
cala-gracio-ibiza.sunbeds: Sun loungers and parasols for rent with a minimum restaurant spend.
cala-gracio-ibiza.food: Gracio beach bar and restaurant; El Chiringuito at Gracioneta.
cala-gracio-ibiza.note: Showers reported turned off to save water. Book a table to improve parking chances.

sa-tuna-beach-begur.access: On foot from nearby coves: Aiguafreda is about 10 minutes away and Ses Negres about 17.
sa-tuna-beach-begur.food: Hotel Sa Tuna has a restaurant by the beach.
sa-tuna-beach-begur.note: Small cove with a hotel on the front.

plage-de-sana-banyuls-sur-mer.access: Via the Centre Helio-Marin road; regulated access.
plage-de-sana-banyuls-sur-mer.parking: Roadside marked spaces; free in winter and paid in summer (one report)
plage-de-sana-banyuls-sur-mer.food: No beach bar; restaurants in town a few minutes away.
plage-de-sana-banyuls-sur-mer.note: Not supervised in summer, unlike neighbouring Petites Elmes (20 June to 6 September 2026). Public toilet near the accessible spaces.

cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.access: Sheltered pebble beach by the harbour breakwater in the town centre; bring water shoes.
cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.parking: Paid car park on the right; three accessible spaces 50 to 100 m from the beach.
cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.food: Several restaurants and bars close by.
cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.note: Lifeguard post July and August 10:30 to 18:30. Peyrefite cove 2.5 km away is also supervised.

saint-cyprien-beach-pyrenees-orientales.access: Long sandy resort beach divided into sectors, with accessible facilities at some.
saint-cyprien-beach-pyrenees-orientales.parking: Paid parking in July and August at the main sectors.
saint-cyprien-beach-pyrenees-orientales.note: Supervised on most of the beach; a stretch near the tourist office is not. Showers and toilets at Pont Tournant and Lagune.

pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.access: Easy; several small coves near the old town.
pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.parking: Small free lot at Sablons; limited spaces
pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.sunbeds: Beach club at Noeveillard; mattress rental unconfirmed at others.
pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.food: Snacks and tables at Noeveillard; a kiosk at Sablons April to September.
pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.note: Noeveillard is supervised and accessible. Sablons has no summer lifeguard in one listing.

plage-des-dames-noirmoutier.access: Flat approach. A free Gratibus shuttle runs from the Noirmoutier-en-l Ile bus station about every 15 minutes, or you can cycle.
plage-des-dames-noirmoutier.parking: Hard in summer. Paid car park on Avenue Georges Clemenceau (17 spaces, 10:00-20:00 in season); free street parking if you arrive early.
plage-des-dames-noirmoutier.food: No restaurant on the beach; shops, restaurants and bars in town about 400 m away.
plage-des-dames-noirmoutier.note: Known for its retro beach cabins and the pier.

plage-de-caroual-erquy.access: Easy; short walk from the car park.
plage-de-caroual-erquy.parking: Parking by the beach; details not confirmed
plage-de-caroual-erquy.food: A restaurant among the beach services; crepes and snacks nearby.
plage-de-caroual-erquy.note: Official tourism site: family beach, lifeguard post during opening hours, dogs banned 15 May to 15 September.

wissant-beach-cote-d-opale.access: Flat beach about 12 km long, good for kitesurfing and windsurfing.
wissant-beach-cote-d-opale.parking: Not confirmed; beach car parks not found in sources
wissant-beach-cote-d-opale.food: Seafood and vegetarian restaurants in the village.
wissant-beach-cote-d-opale.note: Several kitesurf schools; a lesson is around EUR 130. A motorhome area is in the village.

pomena-beach-mljet.access: Walk from the village; inside Mljet National Park.
pomena-beach-mljet.food: Hotel, a couple of restaurants and cafes; Konoba Adriatic and Konoba Antika.
pomena-beach-mljet.note: Park entrance at Pomena; the Small Lake is about 15 minutes on foot. A small islet shelters the bay.

srebreno-beach-dubrovnik-riviera.access: Small pebble beach on the Dubrovnik Riviera, about a 2-minute walk from the village.
srebreno-beach-dubrovnik-riviera.parking: Public beach parking not confirmed; nearby lodgings advertise their own.
srebreno-beach-dubrovnik-riviera.food: Cafes and restaurants nearby; Sveti Jakov beach bar is about 14 minutes away by car.
srebreno-beach-dubrovnik-riviera.note: Source coverage is thin; check locally.

viganj-beach-peljesac.access: Easy; pebble beaches along the village.
viganj-beach-peljesac.parking: Public parking not confirmed; campsites have their own
viganj-beach-peljesac.food: Beach bars such as Bofor and K2; campsite restaurants and taverns.
viganj-beach-peljesac.note: Croatia top windsurf spot with steady afternoon maestral wind; surf and kite school near the camp beach.

igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.access: Easy; pebble beach in the village.
igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.parking: Parking not confirmed; free roadside spots by the quieter beaches
igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.food: Restoran More, Restaurant Ante and Bistro Plaza 34 nearby.
igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.note: Showers, changing rooms and water sports rental. Some naturist sections.

soverato-beach-calabria.access: Long Calabrian beach with about 42 lidi along the seafront.
soverato-beach-calabria.parking: Both paid and free parking near the beaches.
soverato-beach-calabria.sunbeds: Lidi rent umbrella plus two sunbeds; prices vary by season and not confirmed.
soverato-beach-calabria.food: Lidi have bars and restaurants; cabins and hot showers available.
soverato-beach-calabria.note: Family lidi offer play areas and beach volleyball. Free stretches exist at nearby Caminia and Pietragrande.

punta-secca-beach-sicily.access: Easy; walk from the village to the beach below the Montalbano house.
punta-secca-beach-sicily.parking: Limited parking near the marina; a free public car park reported
punta-secca-beach-sicily.sunbeds: Paid lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; free sections too.
punta-secca-beach-sicily.food: Restaurant and snack bar at the lido on nearby Anticaglie.
punta-secca-beach-sicily.note: Anticaglie is sandier and wider. Parking is tight in summer.

xlendi-bay-gozo.access: Easy; flat promenade, small pebble beach.
xlendi-bay-gozo.parking: Small free area plus street parking; tight in peak season
xlendi-bay-gozo.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas often for rent (unconfirmed).
xlendi-bay-gozo.food: Waterfront restaurants such as Ta Karolina.
xlendi-bay-gozo.note: Swimmers also use the flat rocks on either side. Much quieter outside summer.

kapsali-beach-kythira.access: Easy; two crescent bays around a peninsula with a lighthouse.
kapsali-beach-kythira.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas available; extent varies by source.
kapsali-beach-kythira.food: Fish tavernas about 50 m away and many restaurants and cafes.
kapsali-beach-kythira.note: Blue Flag. Showers and changing rooms; water sports rental in summer. One bay is lively and the other quiet.

dafni-beach-zakynthos.access: Rough access road reported; improved in recent years.
dafni-beach-zakynthos.parking: Parking at the end of the track; a reviewer reported pressure from touts
dafni-beach-zakynthos.sunbeds: Sunbeds at the tavern; reports of EUR 10 to EUR 30 per pair.
dafni-beach-zakynthos.food: Dafni taverna serves food; reviewers praise the moussaka.
dafni-beach-zakynthos.note: Inside the National Marine Park; Caretta caretta turtles nest here, so keep noise and lights down.

fava-beach-vourvourou.access: Drive to within about 50 m of the beach; the walk is under two minutes.
fava-beach-vourvourou.parking: Free parking reported by one source, paid by another; check locally
fava-beach-vourvourou.food: No bar; bring food and water.
fava-beach-vourvourou.note: Unorganised beach. Natural shade only in the afternoon. A Greek Herald report says part of the beach was set for auction; check the current status.

piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.parking: Parking at the lidos; not confirmed for free lots
piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.sunbeds: Lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; example Lido Verde about 1 km away.
piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.food: Bar or restaurant at the lidos.
piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.note: Free sections have few facilities. Details for this exact beach are thin.

is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.access: Short walk from the car park.
is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.parking: Paid, about EUR 2.50-3 per hour reported; tickets are checked quickly.
is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.sunbeds: Bring your own umbrella; no fee to use the sand was reported.
is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.food: Bar and restaurants near the beach, close to the tower.
is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.note: Quartz sand like rice grains; taking sand is prohibited and fined. Free shower area reported.

metaponto-beach-basilicata.access: Lido di Metaponto has equipped areas and wide free beach framed by pine woods.
metaponto-beach-basilicata.parking: Parking at lidi such as Il Delfino; public lots not confirmed.
metaponto-beach-basilicata.sunbeds: Lidi rent umbrellas and loungers; prices vary by season.
metaponto-beach-basilicata.food: Lido bars; hot and cold showers at some.
metaponto-beach-basilicata.note: Blue Flag reported. Marina di Pisticci has about 8 km of fine sand. Sand colour described as golden or black by different sources.

okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.access: Easy; long pebble beach, steep entry to the water.
okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.parking: Busy in summer and possibly paid; reviewers call it expensive
okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas about EUR 10 per piece (reported, cash only).
okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.food: Many beach bars and a few restaurants; live music in the evening.
okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.note: 2 km pebble beach. Not ideal for toddlers because of the steep slope.

trstenik-beach-peljesac.access: Easy; large pebble beach at the base of the bay.
trstenik-beach-peljesac.food: Restaurants, cafes and a small market within 150 m of the beach (rental listing).
trstenik-beach-peljesac.note: Details come from rental listings; check locally.

znjan-beach-split.access: Long pebble city beach in Split with large parking lots.
znjan-beach-split.parking: Large lots, widely reported as plentiful and free; busy on weekends and after work.
znjan-beach-split.sunbeds: Conflicting reports: some bars give free loungers, other sources say no rental; bring your own to be safe.
znjan-beach-split.food: Beach bars such as Congo Cafe, Corto Maltese and Amphora; waterpark for kids.
znjan-beach-split.note: Changing cabins. Little natural shade. Buses 7, 8 and 15 serve Znjan.

stobrec-beach-split.access: Blue Flag pebble beach next to Stobrec village, about 9 km from central Split.
stobrec-beach-split.parking: More than 100 asphalt parking spaces near the south beach reported.
stobrec-beach-split.sunbeds: Parasols and sunbeds can be rented on the beach.
stobrec-beach-split.food: Beach bar Amor-Ra on the south beach.
stobrec-beach-split.note: About 15 minutes by car or local bus from central Split.

playa-de-sancti-petri-chiclana.access: Flat Atlantic beach; the canal side is calmer.
playa-de-sancti-petri-chiclana.parking: Roadside parking and official car parks behind the dunes; a summer lot of about 400 spaces was planned
playa-de-sancti-petri-chiclana.food: Chiringuitos on the sand (about two at Sancti Petri, 14 at neighbouring La Barrosa).
playa-de-sancti-petri-chiclana.note: Lifeguards in peak season. Showers and toilets. Very busy in July and August.

playa-de-salobrena-granada.access: Two main beaches: Playa de la Charca and Playa de La Guardia.
playa-de-salobrena-granada.parking: Easy street parking at La Charca; at La Guardia, street parking or a public car park behind Restaurante La Bahia.
playa-de-salobrena-granada.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for hire at La Charca.
playa-de-salobrena-granada.food: Seafront chiringuitos serve sardines, octopus and grilled squid.
playa-de-salobrena-granada.note: Toilets and showers at La Charca. Lifeguard at La Guardia reported by one source.

saint-cast-beach-brittany.access: Easy; flat sand next to the car park.
saint-cast-beach-brittany.parking: Free car park a few steps from the sand; two spaces for reduced mobility
saint-cast-beach-brittany.food: No beach restaurant found; snack bar at the nearby campsite.
saint-cast-beach-brittany.note: Supervised beach, over 1 km of fine sand. Beach club, sailing courses and boat rental. Bus 214 stops at Pen Guen plage.

playa-de-poo-llanes.access: Easy by car or on foot from Poo village.
playa-de-poo-llanes.parking: Small car park that fills quickly
playa-de-poo-llanes.food: A chiringuito or restaurant on the beach.
playa-de-poo-llanes.note: Showers and a rescue service listed. Width varies from about 300 m at low tide to 30 m at high tide.

playa-de-vega-ribadesella.access: Walk from the campsite car park; about 400 m on a shaded path.
playa-de-vega-ribadesella.parking: Basic parking; campsite charges for its own lot
playa-de-vega-ribadesella.food: Bars and cafes on the sand; campsite bar and restaurant.
playa-de-vega-ribadesella.note: Toilets and showers reported. Camping Playa de Vega sits behind the beach (closed mid-September to mid-June).

playa-de-la-ballota-llanes.access: Small unpaved path down to the beach; access can be challenging.
playa-de-la-ballota-llanes.parking: A small lot above the beach is reported blocked with rocks; a few road-bend spaces
playa-de-la-ballota-llanes.food: A restaurant on site reported by one source.
playa-de-la-ballota-llanes.note: Early arrival advised because of limited parking.

playa-de-barayo-valdes.access: Forest path of about 800 m from the car park, or stairs at the west end. A second access starts at Sabugo.
playa-de-barayo-valdes.parking: Sources disagree: a car park near the top is reported, but one official source says there is none.
playa-de-barayo-valdes.food: None on the beach; the fishing village of Puerto de Vega is about 5 km west.
playa-de-barayo-valdes.note: Inside a partial nature reserve of dunes, marshes and river. Nudism is tolerated in the east. Swells can be strong.

playa-de-liencres-cantabria.access: Short walk from the car park. The dunes are protected, so stay on the paths.
playa-de-liencres-cantabria.parking: Large car park that fills on summer weekends; arrive early.
playa-de-liencres-cantabria.note: Surf school and showers. Best for intermediate surfers. Inside the Dunas de Liencres Natural Park.

praia-de-pantin-valdovino.parking: Free parking; about 10 spaces in the motorhome area
praia-de-pantin-valdovino.food: Restaurant at nearby Apartamentos Las Olas, about 100 m away.
praia-de-pantin-valdovino.note: Expert-level surf with strong rips; showers and a lifeguard reported. Several surf camps nearby.

plage-du-val-andre-brittany.parking: Car park a few minutes away at the small rocky Plage du Val
plage-du-val-andre-brittany.note: Sand over 2.5 km bordered by a pedestrian dyke. Rock formations show at low tide; the sea withdraws far.

plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.access: Easy; three main beaches along the front.
plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.parking: Limited in season: boulevard spaces and lots near the tourist office; two lots at Bonne Source
plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.sunbeds: Mattress and cabin rental at Libraires and Bonne Source.
plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.food: Restaurants, a snack bar at Sainte-Marguerite and beach club.
plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.note: Two lifeguard stations at Bonne Source; Sainte-Marguerite lifeguards in July and August. Showers and toilets.

plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.access: Wide Normandy beach with beach cabins, lifeguarded 1 July to 31 August by tide times.
plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.parking: Main lots on rue Eugene Meriel and avenue de Verdun near the Cap Romain cliffs; accessible parking across from the Saint-Aubin hotel.
plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.sunbeds: Not confirmed; beach cabins are private.
plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.food: About five seafront restaurants; Le Crabe Vert is the landmark.
