plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.note: Dogs barred from the central stretch in summer, from Le Crabe Vert to the sailing club.

plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.access: Wide Normandy beach near the town centre, with beach cabins.
plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.parking: Free public car park on Boulevard Marechal, about 400 m away.
plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.food: Takeaway kiosk at nearby Riva Bella; restaurants in town.
plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.note: Swimming watched by SNSM rescuers in summer. Toilets near the beach.

baratti-beach-tuscany.access: Free public beach in a wide gulf; Baratti is easiest for parking before 10 am on weekends.
baratti-beach-tuscany.sunbeds: Paid lido Bagno Baratti (about EUR 23 for two beds and a parasol, reported); Sun Beach Baratti rents umbrellas, loungers, pedal boats, canoes and SUP.
baratti-beach-tuscany.food: Restaurants on the west side of the bay such as Canessa and Torre di Baratti.
baratti-beach-tuscany.note: Free area for your own umbrella.

campese-beach-giglio-island.access: Easy; flat; bus from Giglio Porto about every 20 minutes in summer (about EUR 2).
campese-beach-giglio-island.parking: Sports field behind the beach, about EUR 1 per hour or EUR 3 per day; blue spaces about EUR 7 per day
campese-beach-giglio-island.sunbeds: Lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; free stretches remain.
campese-beach-giglio-island.food: Bars and restaurants at the lidos and nearby.
campese-beach-giglio-island.note: Giglio's largest beach. Public toilets, showers and pedal boats. Costs are reported and may change.

follonica-beach-tuscany.access: Long gulf beach with about 45 lidi and extensive free stretches from Boschetto to Pratoranieri.
follonica-beach-tuscany.parking: Parking areas near lidi, such as at Il Boschetto; public lot fees not confirmed.
follonica-beach-tuscany.sunbeds: Lidi charge about 20 to 40 EUR for umbrella plus two sunbeds.
follonica-beach-tuscany.note: The council funds lifeguards on free beaches too.

xerokambos-beach-crete.access: Long, narrow road; about 90 minutes from Sitia.
xerokambos-beach-crete.parking: Small free parking area near the beach; arrive early in summer
xerokambos-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sources disagree: a few sunbeds at Long Beach or none.
xerokambos-beach-crete.food: Tavernas in the village of Xerokambos.

armier-bay-malta.access: Northern Malta bay with part of the beach reserved for rental operators; Little Armier is quieter.
armier-bay-malta.parking: Parking can be tricky; arrive very early.
armier-bay-malta.sunbeds: Two beach clubs rent sunbeds and umbrellas.
armier-bay-malta.food: A few restaurants and bars along the shore.
armier-bay-malta.note: Public toilets and water sports. Bus only in summer, with a 15 to 20 minute walk. Packed in summer.

playa-de-mazagon-huelva.access: Urban stretch is step-free; Cuesta Maneli needs a 20 minute boardwalk walk.
playa-de-mazagon-huelva.parking: Reference car park on Avenida de los Conquistadores
playa-de-mazagon-huelva.food: Chiringuito Casa Colon and others; Cuesta Maneli has chiringuitos too.
playa-de-mazagon-huelva.note: Lifeguards and showers on the urban stretch. Cuesta Maneli has no car access and lifeguard cover is unconfirmed.

playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.access: Sand beach with lifeguard huts and toilets only; reached by one road from Paseo del Parque.
playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.parking: Parking gets difficult on summer weekends.
playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.sunbeds: No sunbeds on the beach; nearby beach clubs offer day membership.
playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.food: No chiringuito on the beach; Torreguadiaro nearby has bars and seafood restaurants.
playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.note: Torreguadiaro has about 300 parking spaces, sunbed hire and showers.

playa-de-castelldefels-barcelona.access: Long urban beach along the Passeig Maritim, with accessible services and the Rodalies R2 Sud station nearby.
playa-de-castelldefels-barcelona.parking: Municipal car park on Passeig Maritim of about 500 spaces, paid in summer at about 2 EUR per hour and full before 10:00 in August; free street spots 500 to 800 m away. Sources disagree.
playa-de-castelldefels-barcelona.note: Lifeguards, showers and toilets. Arrive early or come by train in peak season.

playa-de-isla-canela-huelva.access: On foot from the urban area; about 1.5 km long and 40 m wide.
playa-de-isla-canela-huelva.sunbeds: Sunshade and sun lounger rental listed.
playa-de-isla-canela-huelva.food: Chiringuitos nearby such as Bombadill and La Cabra II.
playa-de-isla-canela-huelva.note: Lifeguards, toilets, showers, footwash and a tourist office listed.

praia-de-caminha-minho.access: Easy; river mouth beach near town.
praia-de-caminha-minho.parking: Free lot at Largo da Feira reported, about 25 spaces and EUR 3 (2016 listing; closed some market days)
praia-de-caminha-minho.note: Also called Foz do Minho. Camarido beach lies beside a park. Details are thin; check locally.

kalathas-beach-chania.parking: Free street parking fills fast; paid private lots about EUR 4-5
kalathas-beach-chania.sunbeds: Two sunbeds and an umbrella about EUR 15 per day (one guide).
kalathas-beach-chania.food: A taverna at the back of the beach in summer; others a short walk.
kalathas-beach-chania.note: Arrive before 11 am in July and August.

finikounda-beach-messinia.parking: Public parking not confirmed; village streets
finikounda-beach-messinia.sunbeds: Organised sections with sunbeds and umbrellas; some free with a drink.
finikounda-beach-messinia.food: Tavernas on the sand and fish restaurants in the village.
finikounda-beach-messinia.note: Windsurfing and kite spots nearby at Anemomilos and Ligonammos thanks to steady wind.

vlychada-beach-santorini.access: Easy by car or public bus; terrain is rocky.
vlychada-beach-santorini.parking: Free parking reported near the port and cafe
vlychada-beach-santorini.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent; about EUR 10 for two beds and an umbrella (reported, 2023).
vlychada-beach-santorini.food: A few tavernas above the small port and beach bars.
vlychada-beach-santorini.note: No lifeguards. Water shoes recommended. Windy in summer.

methoni-beach-messinia.access: Easy; flat sand below the castle.
methoni-beach-messinia.parking: Free parking reported near the beach; not official
methoni-beach-messinia.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent; about EUR 6 reported, some free at hotels.
methoni-beach-messinia.food: A fish taverna on the beach, plus Taverna Nikos nearby.
methoni-beach-messinia.note: Crescent beach nearly 2 km long beneath the Venetian castle, with pine forest behind.

fornillo-beach-positano.access: About 10 minutes on foot from Spiaggia Grande, with stairs; not wheelchair friendly.
fornillo-beach-positano.parking: No beach parking; walk from Positano town
fornillo-beach-positano.sunbeds: Lidos rent umbrellas and loungers; free sections remain.
fornillo-beach-positano.food: Sea-view restaurants and a handful of summer beach bars.
fornillo-beach-positano.note: Public toilets and showers at the lidos. Pebbles are hard on bare feet, so water shoes help.

serapo-beach-gaeta.parking: Free and paid parking nearby; crowded in August
serapo-beach-gaeta.sunbeds: Many lidos rent umbrellas and loungers; paid entry at clubs at the front.
serapo-beach-gaeta.note: Blue Flag in several years. Restrooms and showers; lifeguard cover not confirmed.

ansedonia-beach-tuscany.access: On foot or shuttle to Feniglia and Tagliata beaches beside the promontory.
ansedonia-beach-tuscany.food: Bars and restaurants near the lidos; shops in Orbetello.
ansedonia-beach-tuscany.note: Feniglia has a pine forest nature reserve behind it; bike rental at the forest entrance.

bonassola-beach-liguria.access: Easy; flat access from the village.
bonassola-beach-liguria.parking: Limited parking in town; free parking reported nearby but not confirmed
bonassola-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas by the day or half day; free strips between them.
bonassola-beach-liguria.note: Free showers and toilets reported. Wider free strips lie at each end of the bay.

plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.access: Easy; wide sandy beach below the stilt chalets.
plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.parking: Free car parks along the seafront
plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.sunbeds: Pasha Plage and other beach clubs rent loungers and beds.
plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.food: Le Paparazzo beach restaurant and club restaurants.
plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.note: Plage des Chalets is the main beach. Lifeguard dates not confirmed.

plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.access: Plage des Minimes next to the marina, with access for reduced mobility.
plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.parking: Port car park on avenue du Lazaret and a large lot behind the beach; a free option is not available in July and August.
plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.food: About ten snack bars and fish restaurants around the port; more on Stella Maris lane.
plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.note: Supervised in summer. The left end near Stella Maris is unsupervised with sharp rocks; swim on the right. Sea bus to the Old Port.

plage-d-arcachon-gironde.access: Central beach of about 800 m between the Eyrac and Thiers piers, along a promenade.
plage-d-arcachon-gironde.parking: Car parks at Place du Docteur Peyneau (by Eyrac pier) and Place Carnot; Indigo Centre-Ville/Plage car park of 600 spaces.
plage-d-arcachon-gironde.sunbeds: Parasol and lounger rental at Pereire beach; central beach not confirmed.
plage-d-arcachon-gironde.food: Many restaurants and cafes along the promenade.
plage-d-arcachon-gironde.note: Lifeguard post in summer near rue Grenier. Pereire beach also supervised with a paid car park.

plage-de-la-ciotat-provence.access: Plage Lumiere is a fine-sand town beach in La Ciotat; dogs not allowed and non-smoking.
plage-de-la-ciotat-provence.parking: Paid parking nearby, first two hours free and free from 7 pm to 9 am reported; also Boulevard Beaurivage and the port of Saint-Jean.
plage-de-la-ciotat-provence.food: Hotels, restaurants and cafes with sea terraces nearby.

plage-du-barcares-pyrenees-orientales.access: Long sandy beach with four lifeguard stations equipped for reduced mobility, with showers, adapted toilets and tiralo chairs.
plage-du-barcares-pyrenees-orientales.parking: Parking details not confirmed; motorhomes are not accepted in the town.
plage-du-barcares-pyrenees-orientales.sunbeds: Not confirmed; private beach clubs exist nearby.
plage-du-barcares-pyrenees-orientales.note: SNSM lifeguards in summer, a dog zone is set by municipal decree. CRS beach patrol reported in 2020.

plage-de-valras-herault.access: Wide sandy beach in Valras-Plage with restaurants facing the sand.
plage-de-valras-herault.parking: Parking paid from 15 June to 15 September, reportedly 30 EUR per day for non-residents (rental listing, verify).
plage-de-valras-herault.food: Many restaurants and cafes opposite the beach.
plage-de-valras-herault.note: Firefighters and lifeguards on duty June to September, emergency room on the beach.

damouchari-beach-pelion.access: Very small car park at the top, then a staircase. Cars and campervans cannot reach the beach.
damouchari-beach-pelion.parking: Very small lot at the top.
damouchari-beach-pelion.sunbeds: Loungers under the olive trees next to the taverna for a small fee.
damouchari-beach-pelion.note: Mix of pebbles and sand with a rocky seabed. Changing cabins and a shower. A few opening scenes of Mamma Mia were shot at the harbour.

nikiana-beach-lefkada.access: Easy; pebbly strip about 600 m long with trees for shade.
nikiana-beach-lefkada.parking: Parking at the bigger Episkopos beach to the north
nikiana-beach-lefkada.sunbeds: About one row of hotel sunbeds; NV Beach Bar rents daybeds.
nikiana-beach-lefkada.food: Harbour tavernas with fresh fish; NV Beach Bar.
nikiana-beach-lefkada.note: Less developed than other Lefkada resorts.

vasiliki-beach-lefkada.access: Easy from the village; two sides are 5-10 minutes apart.
vasiliki-beach-lefkada.sunbeds: Sunbeds near the busy west end and bars.
vasiliki-beach-lefkada.food: Tavernas along the harbour side; bars at the beach end.
vasiliki-beach-lefkada.note: Famed windsurf bay: gentle morning breeze and stronger afternoon wind. Rental and lessons on the sand. Grey shingle over sand.

agios-nikitas-beach-lefkada.access: Village beach reached on foot; the headland path to Mylos takes about 20 minutes and can be rough, or take the taxi boat (a couple of euros).
agios-nikitas-beach-lefkada.parking: Car parks in the village fill in July and August; the main street is pedestrian-only
agios-nikitas-beach-lefkada.sunbeds: Plenty of sunbed pairs and umbrellas for rent.
agios-nikitas-beach-lefkada.food: Several tavernas, bars and minimarkets close to the sand.

praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.parking: Very large lot behind the dunes; fills in peak summer
praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.sunbeds: Sunshade rental at the concession areas.
praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.food: Bar and restaurant at the concessions.
praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.note: Strong waves for surf and bodyboard; currents, so swim near the lifeguard. Showers.

praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.access: Cascais coast beach reached by ramp from the cliff-top car park or by stairs, ramp or tunnel from the S. Pedro do Estoril station.
praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.parking: Use the designated area off the Marginal (EN6); car park on the cliff top.
praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.sunbeds: Sunshade rental listed; sunbed operator not confirmed.
praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.food: A restaurant and bar at the beach; others nearby.
praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.note: Lifeguard and flag service in bathing season. Showers, toilets and first aid. Surf and windsurf popular.

praia-da-fonte-da-telha-costa-da-caparic.access: Reached by road; the mini train serves the beach.
praia-da-fonte-da-telha-costa-da-caparic.food: Restaurants and bars; each section is tied to a restaurant.
praia-da-fonte-da-telha-costa-da-caparic.note: Southern terminus of the Transpraia mini train. Nine supervised stretches. The naturist area is to the north, with parking at Bela Vista.

praia-da-lagoa-de-albufeira-sesimbra.access: Easy; lagoon on one side and sea on the other.
praia-da-lagoa-de-albufeira-sesimbra.note: Blue Flag, lifeguard and showers. Dangerous currents where the lagoon meets the sea; the sea side has stronger waves.

praia-da-consolacao-peniche.parking: Shared car park with the north neighbour beach; numerous spaces
praia-da-consolacao-peniche.food: Several restaurants nearby such as Taverna dos Arcos.
praia-da-consolacao-peniche.note: Blue Flag, lifeguard, showers and a bar.

praia-verde-castro-marim.access: Easy; flat beach by the nature area.
praia-verde-castro-marim.parking: Outdoor parking; free on site for hotel guests
praia-verde-castro-marim.food: Hotel restaurant and a well-regarded restaurant in the beach area.
praia-verde-castro-marim.note: Security or surveillance listed; lifeguard dates not confirmed.

praia-da-prainha-alvor.access: Short walk from the resort; a lift is built into the complex.
praia-da-prainha-alvor.parking: Parking at the resort is for guests; public parking not confirmed
praia-da-prainha-alvor.sunbeds: A reviewer reported EUR 19 for two sunbeds in 2023.
praia-da-prainha-alvor.food: A bar and snack bar at the resort.
praia-da-prainha-alvor.note: Details for the public beach are thin; check on arrival.

praia-da-batata-lagos.access: Steps down from the cliff town.
praia-da-batata-lagos.sunbeds: Sources disagree: no rental per one guide, about EUR 15 per day per another.
praia-da-batata-lagos.food: Batata Beach Bar and cliff-top restaurants.
praia-da-batata-lagos.note: Lifeguards in summer; public toilets; wheelchair accessible per one source. Seaweed complaints. Lost its Blue Flag in 2020.

playa-de-santa-ponsa-mallorca.parking: Free and paid parking around the resort
playa-de-santa-ponsa-mallorca.sunbeds: Sunbed and umbrella about EUR 12 per set (hotel listing) to EUR 20 per day (review).
playa-de-santa-ponsa-mallorca.note: Lifeguard on site. Calm water suits families.

vignanotica-beach-gargano.access: Two ways in: a paid car park near the bay with a stairway or shuttle down, or the 2.5 to 3 km Mergoli-Vignanotica trail from the SP53 between Vieste and Mattinata (unpaved, wear sturdy shoes).
vignanotica-beach-gargano.parking: Paid lots near the bay (one visitor reported EUR 10); only a few spaces at the trailhead.
vignanotica-beach-gargano.sunbeds: Lidos with sunbeds operate in peak summer; the beach is quiet the rest of the year.
vignanotica-beach-gargano.food: Toilets and refreshment points in summer.
vignanotica-beach-gargano.note: About 500 m of sand and pebbles below steep white cliffs with caves. The beach is on the border of Vieste and Mattinata.

praia-a-mare-beach-calabria.access: Easy; 2 km beach, sandy in the north and pebbly in the south.
praia-a-mare-beach-calabria.parking: Free street parking and a paid lot close to the beach
praia-a-mare-beach-calabria.sunbeds: About 50 lidos in summer rent sunbeds and umbrellas; some free stretches.
praia-a-mare-beach-calabria.note: Isola di Dino caves are reached by paddle boat or canoe from lidos, May to September.

acciaroli-beach-cilento.access: Easy from the town; long fine-sand beach.
acciaroli-beach-cilento.sunbeds: Local vendors rent sunbeds and umbrellas; free tracts too.
acciaroli-beach-cilento.food: Cafes and restaurants in the village.
acciaroli-beach-cilento.note: Blue Flag in many years. Spiaggia Grande is rarely crowded.

trentova-beach-agropoli.access: Easy; narrow sand strip in Trentova bay.
trentova-beach-agropoli.parking: Paid municipal lot about 100 m away, about EUR 7 per day in summer (listing)
trentova-beach-agropoli.sunbeds: Lidos at Trentova rent umbrellas and sunbeds; prices not confirmed.
trentova-beach-agropoli.food: Bars and restaurants near the lidos.

marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.access: Down from Nerano by road or in summer by shuttle from Sant Agata.
marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.parking: Paid parking about EUR 10 per day (reported); summer shuttle from Sant Agata
marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.sunbeds: Concessions rent umbrellas and sunbeds; free beach too.
marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.food: Restaurants on the beach, such as Taverna del Capitano.
marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.note: Pebble beach. Spaghetti alla Nerano is the local dish. Bathing season runs about April to October.

le-bombarde-beach-alghero.access: Beach 7-10 km north of Alghero in Porto Conte Natural Park; local buses run from Alghero.
le-bombarde-beach-alghero.parking: Paid parking in peak season (free after 9 pm, reported)
le-bombarde-beach-alghero.sunbeds: J&B beach club rents sunbeds, umbrellas and hammocks.
le-bombarde-beach-alghero.food: Beach clubs, restaurants and bars; reviews of the J&B restaurant are mixed.
le-bombarde-beach-alghero.note: Large free areas remain. Busiest 11:00-16:00 in July and August.

santa-maria-navarrese-beach-ogliastra.parking: Free parking reported, hard to find in summer
santa-maria-navarrese-beach-ogliastra.sunbeds: A sunbed area with umbrellas, plus a free section.
santa-maria-navarrese-beach-ogliastra.food: Bars and kiosks on the strand.
santa-maria-navarrese-beach-ogliastra.note: Toilets and showers reported. Rocky patches and deep water, so not ideal for small children.

isola-rossa-beach-sardinia.access: Easy; central Long Beach and small Li Femini beach.
isola-rossa-beach-sardinia.sunbeds: Lidos and waterfront bars rent umbrellas and chairs.
isola-rossa-beach-sardinia.food: Cafes and beach bars on the waterfront.
isola-rossa-beach-sardinia.note: Shallow clear water. La Marinedda bay is nearby; Cala Rossa is a 10 minute dirt trail walk.

solanas-beach-sardinia.parking: Free parking close by; a quieter lot at the east end
solanas-beach-sardinia.sunbeds: Kiosks rent umbrellas, loungers, pedal boats and SUPs.
solanas-beach-sardinia.food: Several bars on the beach in summer.
solanas-beach-sardinia.note: About 1 km of sand. Services run June to September.

cala-mari-pintau-sardinia.access: Short walk along a vegetated path from the road.
cala-mari-pintau-sardinia.parking: Free roadside parking with no equipped car park; arrive before 10 am in high season
cala-mari-pintau-sardinia.food: Kiosk-bar and a small cafe on the path; toilets.
cala-mari-pintau-sardinia.note: Blue Flag for several years. Mostly pebbles with fine white sand further out. About 20 km from Cagliari.

li-mindi-beach-badesi.access: About 50 m on foot through dunes from the car park.
li-mindi-beach-badesi.parking: Large car park behind the dunes; cheap per day
li-mindi-beach-badesi.sunbeds: No concessions here; rentals at Li Junchi, the central beach.
li-mindi-beach-badesi.note: Undeveloped dune beach; bring your own shade. Seaweed and strong currents reported at times.

portixeddu-beach-buggerru.access: Flat, with high dunes behind parts of the beach.
portixeddu-beach-buggerru.parking: Parking available, free entry; capacity not confirmed
portixeddu-beach-buggerru.sunbeds: Beach equipment, canoe and pedalo rental.
portixeddu-beach-buggerru.note: Strong currents on this coast; take care when swimming. A pine grove with picnic areas sits behind the beach. Buggerru is about 6 km away.

palasa-beach-albanian-riviera.access: Turnoff from the SH8 just below the Llogara Pass tunnel, about 8 km north of Dhermi.
palasa-beach-albanian-riviera.sunbeds: Paid club sections; sets reported at EUR 8-25, sources disagree.
palasa-beach-albanian-riviera.note: Free public stretches at the edges of the 1.5 km beach. Club sections fill in July and August. Prices come mainly from one local site.

golem-beach-albania.access: Long sandy Adriatic beach lined with beach clubs, loungers and parasols.
golem-beach-albania.parking: Public beach parking not confirmed; free street parking noted near some rentals.
golem-beach-albania.sunbeds: Organised clubs with sunloungers and parasols; prices not confirmed.
golem-beach-albania.food: Promenade cafes, bars and restaurants such as Fafa for seafood; busy evenings.
golem-beach-albania.note: Water sports operators on the beach.

lalzit-bay-beach-albania.access: Wide Adriatic bay with child-friendly beaches north of Durres.
lalzit-bay-beach-albania.parking: Public beach parking not confirmed; parking is per property.
lalzit-bay-beach-albania.sunbeds: Sunbeds and parasols for rent for a daily fee.
lalzit-bay-beach-albania.food: Eateries and bars along the seafront by the resorts; supermarkets nearby.
lalzit-bay-beach-albania.note: Scuba diving, jet-skiing, water-skiing and a children playground.

rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.access: Easy; flat beach below the promenade.
rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.parking: Shaded lot at the entrance about EUR 5 per day (review); paid in peak season
rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.sunbeds: Front row about EUR 25 for two; second row about EUR 15; part of the beach is free but without chairs.
rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.food: Beach bars and restaurants; small beer about EUR 2.90 (review).
rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.note: Fills up by about 10:00 and is almost full by noon in peak season.

ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.access: Flat, on the island at the Bojana river mouth.
ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.parking: Reports differ: EUR 5 per car, or EUR 2 per hour up to EUR 10 per day
ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.sunbeds: Two chairs and an umbrella about EUR 15 (July 2025 report); towel space is free.
ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.food: Beach bars and restaurants close by.
ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.note: The organised nudist section charges entry. Check prices on arrival.

marsaskala-bay-malta.access: Marsaskala Bay with nearby St Thomas Bay, a sandy bay with shallow water.
marsaskala-bay-malta.parking: Parking at St Thomas Bay listed; fees not confirmed.
marsaskala-bay-malta.sunbeds: Equipment hire listed at St Thomas Bay; sunbeds not confirmed.
marsaskala-bay-malta.food: A bar and cafe at St Thomas Bay; a restaurant by Fajtata Bay.
marsaskala-bay-malta.note: Swim notices have changed over the years; check current Environmental Health bathing water notices.

drvenik-beach-dalmatia.access: Easy; two bays near the ferry port.
drvenik-beach-dalmatia.food: Konobas nearby such as Konoba Jelas and Caffe Bar Lanterna.
drvenik-beach-dalmatia.note: Ferry to Hvar leaves from the village. Donja vala and Gornja vala are the two bays.

zivogosce-beach-makarska-riviera.access: Easy; pebble beach with pine shade at Blato.
zivogosce-beach-makarska-riviera.parking: Public parking not confirmed; rentals offer private spots
zivogosce-beach-makarska-riviera.food: Restaurants, cafes and a shop within about 70 m (rental listing).
zivogosce-beach-makarska-riviera.note: Reports differ on sand versus gravel; most describe fine gravel.

costa-calma-beach-fuerteventura.access: Long sheltered white-sand beach beside hotels; windy Sotavento is a short drive away.
costa-calma-beach-fuerteventura.food: Restaurants and shops in the nearby shopping centre; hotel cafes and bars.
costa-calma-beach-fuerteventura.note: Lifeguard cover and water activities in season.

playa-de-amadores-gran-canaria.parking: Street parking behind the beach (free and paid options reported)
playa-de-amadores-gran-canaria.sunbeds: Sunbeds and parasols for rent; about EUR 15 for two plus parasol.
playa-de-amadores-gran-canaria.food: Restaurants, snack bars and bars along the beach.
playa-de-amadores-gran-canaria.note: Blue Flag and lifeguards. Toilets about EUR 0.70, showers EUR 2, lockers EUR 1.50. Wheelchair access aids.

playa-del-ingles-gran-canaria.sunbeds: Sunbed rental, about EUR 7.50 for two with an umbrella (reported).
playa-del-ingles-gran-canaria.note: Lifeguards and showers (no soap) at entrances. Promenade toilets charge a fee. Gentle slope suits limited mobility.

playa-de-mogan-gran-canaria.access: Easy; small beach beside the marina.
playa-de-mogan-gran-canaria.sunbeds: Sunbeds, sunshades, pedalos and canoes for hire.
playa-de-mogan-gran-canaria.food: Kiosks plus port restaurants such as Belin and Fragata II.
playa-de-mogan-gran-canaria.note: Calm sheltered beach by Puerto de Mogan.

playa-de-el-medano-tenerife.sunbeds: Sun loungers and parasols for hire.
playa-de-el-medano-tenerife.food: Bars and restaurants; El Cabezo kiosk serves light food.
playa-de-el-medano-tenerife.note: Lifeguards, showers, toilets. A kitesurf zone with schools and rentals; the kite area is too windy for casual sunbathing.

playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.access: Sheltered town beach next to the harbour in Los Cristianos, with a promenade behind.
playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.parking: Over 100 spaces reported; pay-parking at the dock by card or cash.
playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.sunbeds: Sunbeds and parasols for hire; one reviewer reported about 9 EUR for two loungers plus umbrella.
playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.food: Dozens of restaurants, bars and cafes along the promenade.
playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.note: Lifeguard not confirmed here; lifeguards reported at neighbouring Las Vistas.

playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.access: Playa de Las Americas is about 500 m long and 60 m wide, with Troya (about 650 m, Blue Flag) next to it.
playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.parking: Parking listed; capacity and charges not confirmed.
playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.sunbeds: Sunbed and umbrella rental for a fee.
playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.food: Resort bars and restaurants behind the beach.
playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.note: Red Cross lifeguard post at Troya, showers and hammocks. Accessibility reported mixed.

playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.access: Easy; the town beach is by the harbour; Es Trenc is further along the coast.
playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.parking: Parking problems reported at Ses Covetes and the town in summer
playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.sunbeds: Sunbed shortage reported in 2022; availability unconfirmed.
playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.food: Restaurants near Es Trenc and in the town.
playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.note: Es Trenc is more than 2 km of dunes and salt marsh in a protected area.

cala-ferrera-mallorca.access: Steps lead down from a small car park to the cove.
cala-ferrera-mallorca.parking: Small car park; about 100 m path from the end of Cal Petit Avenue; arrive early
cala-ferrera-mallorca.sunbeds: Loungers and parasols for rent; some spots reserved for hotel guests.
cala-ferrera-mallorca.food: Beach bar and restaurants such as Marivent.
cala-ferrera-mallorca.note: Small cove; hotel guests fill many sunbeds in season.

platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.access: Two small neighbouring coves share the name: Portals Nous cove (about 60 to 100 m) and De s Oratori.
platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.parking: Free parking around the cove reported by Calvia; Puerto Portals car parks charge and fill at peak times.
platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.sunbeds: Modest selection of sun loungers and parasols at the Caleta.
platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.food: Bars and restaurants at Puerto Portals; small beach bar at De s Oratori.
platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.note: Shower at the Caleta. Lifeguard reported at De s Oratori in summer. Check which cove you mean.

agia-anna-beach-naxos.access: Flat; about 6 km from Naxos Town, buses every half hour in season.
agia-anna-beach-naxos.parking: Public parking at many points by the sea
agia-anna-beach-naxos.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas along most of the beach; hard to get a chair after 11 am in peak season.
agia-anna-beach-naxos.food: Cafes, tavernas and beach bars line the sand.
agia-anna-beach-naxos.note: One of the best organised beaches on Naxos; mini markets and ATMs close by.

acharavi-beach-corfu.access: Very long beach, reported 3 to 7 km, often quiet toward the ends.
acharavi-beach-corfu.parking: No dedicated beach car park; parking along the main road.
acharavi-beach-corfu.food: Beachfront tavernas and bars such as Woodys and Fuego Beach Bar.
acharavi-beach-corfu.note: Water sports including pedalos. Can get busy in July and August.

ipsos-beach-corfu.access: Pebble and shingle beach of about 1.5 km along the main road.
ipsos-beach-corfu.parking: Easy parking along the main road; bus stop at the beach.
ipsos-beach-corfu.sunbeds: Loungers and parasols about 8 to 10 EUR per pair.
ipsos-beach-corfu.food: Strip of beach bars and restaurants such as Marea, Als and Moby Dick.
ipsos-beach-corfu.note: Bring beach shoes. Sources disagree on showers and lifeguards.

almyrida-beach-crete.access: Easy; promenade runs along the beach.
almyrida-beach-crete.parking: Flat unpaved lot near the beach; full by mid-morning in July and August; arrive before 09:30
almyrida-beach-crete.food: Tavernas and cafes along the promenade.
almyrida-beach-crete.note: Blue Flag in listings. Windsurfing, kayaking and SUP available.

agia-pelagia-beach-crete.parking: Reports conflict: plenty in the village, but hard at nearby beaches
agia-pelagia-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas along most of the beach; about EUR 7 per set (one review) up to EUR 25 (2025).
agia-pelagia-beach-crete.food: Tavernas and cafes on the beach that serve to your sunbed.
agia-pelagia-beach-crete.note: Showers and changing rooms nearby. Psaromoura nearby is quieter.

agia-galini-beach-crete.access: Sandy town beach on the south coast of Crete.
agia-galini-beach-crete.food: Tavernas and beach bars such as Kosmas Taverna and Apnea Beach Bar.
agia-galini-beach-crete.note: Restrooms and lifeguard not reported. Can be crowded and noisy in peak summer.

praia-de-matosinhos-porto.access: Long Atlantic city beach reached by Metro line A, with a seafront promenade.
praia-de-matosinhos-porto.parking: Paid and roadside parking listed; specific lots not confirmed.
praia-de-matosinhos-porto.food: Many fish and seafood restaurants and chiringuitos.
praia-de-matosinhos-porto.note: Lifeguard posts active about mid-June to mid-September. Popular surf spot with summer surf schools.

praia-da-fuseta-algarve.access: Easy on the Ria side; a ferry from the marina reaches the island beach.
praia-da-fuseta-algarve.parking: About 120 spaces reported plus town parking
praia-da-fuseta-algarve.food: Marina restaurants grill fish in summer; bars on the beach.
praia-da-fuseta-algarve.note: Ria Formosa Natural Park. Seasonal lifeguards, showers and toilets; dogs barred in bathing season.

mastichari-beach-kos.access: Easy; long sandy beach in the village.
mastichari-beach-kos.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas on the central stretch.
mastichari-beach-kos.food: Traditional tavernas and sea-view cafe bars.
mastichari-beach-kos.note: Kitesurf school just past the sunbeds; one of the windiest spots on Kos. Book lessons ahead.

baia-sardinia-beach.access: Beach in a resort bay on the Costa Smeralda; some nearby beaches use a dirt path of 8-10 minutes from a car park.
baia-sardinia-beach.parking: Paid and street parking in town; spaces fill early in summer
baia-sardinia-beach.sunbeds: Umbrella and lounger rental, reported as expensive.
baia-sardinia-beach.food: Bars and restaurants in town, such as Barracuda and Ristorante Baia Blu.
baia-sardinia-beach.note: Details for this exact beach are thin; check on arrival.

agios-georgios-beach-naxos.access: Short walk from Chora; developed and wilder sections.
agios-georgios-beach-naxos.parking: Free parking nearby; spaces limited in peak season, mainly at the north end
agios-georgios-beach-naxos.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas by hotels, tavernas and cafes.
agios-georgios-beach-naxos.food: Cafe-bars and tavernas along the beach.
agios-georgios-beach-naxos.note: Blue Flag. Showers and toilets, no changing rooms. Southern end is the windsurf area. Shallow water suits kids.

platja-de-sant-pol-costa-brava.access: Easy; flat sand in a sheltered bay.
platja-de-sant-pol-costa-brava.note: Blue Flag, lifeguard, showers, foot wash and toilets (official listing).

prapratno-beach-peljesac.access: Flat walk from the car park to the shore
prapratno-beach-peljesac.parking: Paid parking near the bay in summer
prapratno-beach-peljesac.sunbeds: Rental sunbeds and umbrellas in summer
prapratno-beach-peljesac.food: Beach bar and restaurant in season
prapratno-beach-peljesac.note: Combine it with a visit to the Ston walls and oyster bars, and avoid ferry-queue hours.

lovrecina-bay-brac.access: Short walk from the car park to the shore
lovrecina-bay-brac.parking: Small car park near the bay, fills up in July and August
lovrecina-bay-brac.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent in summer
lovrecina-bay-brac.note: Come in the morning in peak season, when the small car park is still free.

borik-beach-zadar.access: Flat promenade access, suitable for strollers
borik-beach-zadar.parking: Paid parking in lots around the hotels
borik-beach-zadar.food: Several bars and restaurants on the promenade
borik-beach-zadar.note: Walk the promenade at sunset, and bring water shoes for the pebbles.

petrcane-beach-zadar.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent in summer
petrcane-beach-zadar.food: Cafes and restaurants along the promenade
petrcane-beach-zadar.note: Bring sandals for the pebbles and eat at a harbour restaurant at the end of the day.

novi-vinodolski-beach-kvarner.food: Cafes and restaurants on the promenade
novi-vinodolski-beach-kvarner.note: Visit the Frankopan castle in the old centre after your swim.

zanjice-beach-lustica.access: Drive down a narrow road, then a short walk
zanjice-beach-lustica.parking: Small car park at the bay, limited in summer
zanjice-beach-lustica.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent in summer
zanjice-beach-lustica.note: Combine it with a boat trip to the Blue Cave and come early in July and August.

plavi-horizonti-beach-lustica.access: Short walk from the car park
plavi-horizonti-beach-lustica.note: Arrive early in the high season, then eat at a beach restaurant.

veliki-pijesak-beach-ulcinj.access: Flat access from the road or car park
veliki-pijesak-beach-ulcinj.parking: Parking near the beach, usually paid in season
veliki-pijesak-beach-ulcinj.food: Beach bars and cafes in season
veliki-pijesak-beach-ulcinj.note: Weekday mornings are calmer, and the sea is shallow enough for small children.

ghar-lapsi-siggiewi.access: Short walk down from the road to the rocks
ghar-lapsi-siggiewi.parking: Free parking along the road; fills quickly on summer weekends
ghar-lapsi-siggiewi.sunbeds: No sunbeds; bring a towel and shade
ghar-lapsi-siggiewi.note: Bring water shoes and swim only in calm weather.

wied-il-ghasri-gozo.access: Steps down a narrow gorge from the car park
wied-il-ghasri-gozo.parking: Small car park at the top, with a short walk down
wied-il-ghasri-gozo.note: Only swim on calm days, and wear shoes for the steps and rocks.

qbajjar-bay-gozo.access: Flat access over rocks to the water
qbajjar-bay-gozo.note: Combine it with a walk past the Xwejni salt pans.

marsalforn-bay-gozo.parking: Paid and free parking around the promenade
marsalforn-bay-gozo.note: Walk the promenade to the salt pans for sunset.

fond-ghadir-sliema.access: Flat promenade access, then ladders or rocks to enter
fond-ghadir-sliema.parking: Street and paid parking in Sliema, or use the bus
fond-ghadir-sliema.sunbeds: Rental sunbeds and umbrellas in season
fond-ghadir-sliema.food: Cafes and restaurants along the promenade
fond-ghadir-sliema.note: Go on a weekday morning and wear water shoes for the rocks.

anchor-bay-popeye-village.access: Short walk from the car park to the bay
anchor-bay-popeye-village.parking: Paid parking at the village entrance
anchor-bay-popeye-village.note: Visit in the morning, and note the village charges an entrance fee.

shengjin-beach-lezhe.note: Go on a weekday and eat fresh fish at a seafront restaurant.

porto-palermo-beach-himara.access: Short walk from the road to the shore
porto-palermo-beach-himara.note: Visit the castle at the end of the peninsula and swim early in the morning.

grama-bay-karaburun.access: Reached mainly by boat from Vlore
grama-bay-karaburun.parking: No road parking; most visitors arrive by boat from Vlore
grama-bay-karaburun.note: Book a boat trip from Vlore and bring water and shade.

praia-da-oura-albufeira.access: Steps or ramp from the road to the sand
praia-da-oura-albufeira.parking: Paid parking nearby; limited in summer
praia-da-oura-albufeira.note: Come early in summer, and walk west along the sand to Albufeira.

praia-do-vau-portimao.access: Steps from the road down to the sand
praia-do-vau-portimao.parking: Paid parking near the beach; limited in summer
praia-do-vau-portimao.note: Walk the cliff path toward Praia dos Tres Irmaos at the end of the day.

praia-formosa-santa-maria.access: Short walk from the car park
praia-formosa-santa-maria.note: Visit in July or August when the water is warmest and the beach bar is open.

praia-de-porto-pim-horta.note: Combine it with the whaling museum and a walk up Monte da Guia.

agia-anna-beach-amorgos.access: Steps down from the road to the pebbles
agia-anna-beach-amorgos.note: Visit the monastery above, and swim in the morning before the road gets busy.

son-bou-beach-menorca.access: Flat walk from the car park
son-bou-beach-menorca.parking: Paid and free parking near the beach
son-bou-beach-menorca.note: Walk to the far ends of the beach for more space, and arrive early in August.

sougia-beach-crete.access: Mountain road in, then a flat walk to the beach
sougia-beach-crete.parking: Free parking at the entrance of the village
sougia-beach-crete.sunbeds: Limited sunbeds in front of tavernas
sougia-beach-crete.note: Take a ferry or walk to nearby beaches, and swim early as pebbles heat up.

manganari-beach-ios.access: Winding road from Chora, then a short walk
manganari-beach-ios.parking: Parking near the beach, limited in peak season
manganari-beach-ios.note: Go in June or September, and take the boat from Ios port for an easy day trip.

porto-limnionas-zakynthos.access: Short walk down to the rock platforms
porto-limnionas-zakynthos.parking: Small car park above the inlet
porto-limnionas-zakynthos.sunbeds: Rental sunbeds on platforms in season
porto-limnionas-zakynthos.note: Bring water shoes and swim only in calm weather.

sarti-beach-sithonia.parking: Free and paid parking near the village
sarti-beach-sithonia.food: Tavernas and cafes along the beach
sarti-beach-sithonia.note: Visit at sunset for the view of Mount Athos, and go early in August.

ses-illetes-beach-formentera.access: Flat walk from the car park to the sand
ses-illetes-beach-formentera.parking: Paid parking, limited and often full by midday
ses-illetes-beach-formentera.sunbeds: Sunbeds for rent at beach clubs
ses-illetes-beach-formentera.note: Arrive early or take the bus, and respect the protected dune areas.

platja-de-migjorn-formentera.access: Flat walk from road access points
platja-de-migjorn-formentera.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas at beach bars
platja-de-migjorn-formentera.note: Walk along the sand to find a quiet spot, and check the sea state before swimming.

plage-du-lotu-corsica.access: Boat from Saint-Florent or a long walk on a track
plage-du-lotu-corsica.parking: No road access; boat from Saint-Florent or a long unpaved track
plage-du-lotu-corsica.note: Take a boat from Saint-Florent, and bring everything you need.

platja-de-muro-mallorca.parking: Paid parking near several access points
platja-de-muro-mallorca.note: Walk toward the natural park edge for a quieter stretch.

ses-salines-beach-ibiza.access: Short walk from the car park
ses-salines-beach-ibiza.note: Walk along the sand for quieter spots, and avoid walking on the dunes.

plage-de-la-palmyre.food: Cafes and restaurants in the resort
plage-de-la-palmyre.note: Cycle the forest paths, and swim where lifeguards are on duty.

plage-de-la-conche-des-baleines-ile-de-r.note: Cycle from the village and check tide times before swimming.

utah-beach-normandy.access: Flat walk from the car park
utah-beach-normandy.note: Visit the museum first and check the tide before walking on the sand.

plage-de-granville.sunbeds: Beach cabins and some rentals in season
plage-de-granville.note: Check the tide table, and visit the old town above after your swim.

plage-de-palavas-les-flots.food: Restaurants and bars along the seafront
plage-de-palavas-les-flots.note: Take the tram from Montpellier and eat fresh seafood near the canal.

velika-plaza-ulcinj.access: Several access points from the road; flat sand
velika-plaza-ulcinj.parking: Parking near the main access points; limited in peak season
velika-plaza-ulcinj.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas at some beach bars
velika-plaza-ulcinj.food: Beach bars and restaurants at intervals along the sand
velika-plaza-ulcinj.note: Kitesurf schools operate at the southern end near Ada Bojana. The beach is very long, so walk away from the access points for space.

canj-beach.access: Short walk from the hotel strip; sandy entry
canj-beach.parking: Free car park nearby; fills up in peak season
canj-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas in season; not confirmed
canj-beach.food: Bars and restaurants along the beachfront
canj-beach.note: Visitor guides mention crowding at peak hours and mixed comments on toilet cleanliness, so go early in the day.
